USA VA Falls Church

Additional Work Locations:

Total Rewards at GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identity Verification Process:

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes.

About Our Work:

We are GDIT. A global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community. Our 26,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation. We operate across 50+ countries worldwide, offering leading mission-ready capabilities in AI, cloud, cyber and software development.Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on our career opportunities and events at

.

title: SELGER  TELEGRAFEN
description:
Vi ser etter en SUPERSELGER med mye arbeidskapasitet og vinnermentalitet som kan bli en del av Team ONLY TELEGRAFEN denne sommeren!

Vil du bli med på reisen?

ONLY Stores er i sterk utvikling, og vi søker derfor en superselger som kan bli en del av vårt Team.

ONLY Stores har vært på en forrykende reise gjennom de siste fem år, og vi er langt fra ferdige. Vår forretningsplan har vist seg å være rett og vårt hovedfokus på våre medarbeidere og våre varer viser seg å være vår nøkkel til suksess. Som en del av organisasjonen i ONLY Stores kan du i høy grad få det ansvaret du ønsker, de oppgaver du brenner for, og ikke minst være en del av et fantastisk team.

Gjennom våre verdier jobber vi målrettet og strukturert for å nå målene våre.

Vinnermentalitet - nærhet - grunnleggermentalitet - forretningstankegang - lidenskap og hardt arbeid

Hos ONLY Stores vet vi at de medarbeidere som har disse verdiene gjør en stor forskjell!

Jobben

Som deltid selger hos oss så forventer vi at du kjenner deg igjen i verdiene våre, er glad i et høyt tempo hvor ingen dag er lik og ønsker å være en del av og en bidragsyter til teamet ditt. Mote og trender er noe som interesserer deg og du er opptatt av å følge med i markedet.

Har du høyt tempo, konkurranseinstinkt, og du er klar for å ta i et tak! Er du en team player som kan bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø og jobbe sammen med teamet for å nå målene vi setter oss? Mener du også at kunden alltid kommer først? Da vil vi høre fra deg!

Stillingen er en deltidsstilling som vil innebære dag, kveld og helger, men vi har også behov for at du kan stille opp ekstra ved sykdom, varetelling og ferieavvikling. Vi trenger deg som brenner for mote, og har store ambisjoner for videreutvikling hos ONLY TELEGRAFEN

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Wilmington, North Carolina.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Wilmington area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Wilmington requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Powell, Ohio.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Powell area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Powell requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Concord, Massachusetts.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Concord area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Concord requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Product Manager (Growth - B2B Enterprise)
description:

This position is based in Adobe India’s Bangalore office; You should be able to work in a hybrid model needing to come into the office at least 3 days in a week.

The group passionate about Enterprise Growth (within Adobe’s Unified Platform organization) is seeking a Product Manager. This role will own Product-Led Growth (PLG) across our B2B Enterprise business and turn end-user demand into enterprise-wide adoption. Our team is building new ways to bring enterprise customers into Adobe beyond traditional sales and marketing motions, workflows that channel individual product usage into broader enterprise adoption, pairing free product access and personalized onboarding with in-product signals that point our sales team to the next upsell opportunity.

In this position, you will own and drive PLG initiatives. These initiatives turn grassroots, end-user demand into enterprise-wide adoption. You'll partner with cross-functional teams in engineering, building, analytics, and go-to-market to define and ship impactful product experiences.

What You'll Do

This role fits someone in product management beyond entry-level execution. They are ready for increased ownership and growth toward the senior PM level. You'll have meaningful autonomy, the opportunity to drive real impact, and strong mentorship along the way.

  • Own the roadmap and prioritization for turning end-user demand into enterprise-wide adoption — from onboarding and activation through the signals that flag an account as ready to expand.
  • Turn hunches into structured experiments — write test charters, run A/B tests, and use the results to make the call on what ships next.
  • Dig into dashboards, funnel data, and usage signals to find where the biggest opportunities sit and confirm that shipped features are actually moving the needle.
  • Work closely with go-to-market, technical, creative, and analytics teams to bring features to market. These features drive enterprise acquisition and revenue. They can also be reused across other Adobe product lines.
  • Be the customer advocate every step of the way — help the entire product team see what makes the difference between just another feature and a customer delight!

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5+ years experience, with a track record of shepherding initiatives from idea through launch. Experience in a growth or data-heavy role is a plus.
  • Experience driving growth directly from the product is important, ideally with free, freemium, trial, or conversion models. You understand what motivates users to pay. You have shipped features that demonstrate this.
  • A natural inclination toward data with ability to define what success looks like and using the numbers to steer prioritization and strategy.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required — an MBA or related master's degree is a plus, not a mandate.
  • Experience with AI: We seek a candidate experienced in building or working with AI-powered features or products. The candidate should also be eager to keep learning and growing in this area.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

title: Clinician
description:
Department: Youth Prevention & Intervention

Program: Community Assessment Team/Juvenile Diversion

Status: Exempt, regular, full-time

$100,000 (Licensed with LCSW, MFT or LPCC)

# of Openings: 1


Who we are

SBCS (formerly South Bay Community Services) transforms communities to support the well-being and prosperity of children, youth, and families. For more than 50 years, we’ve worked throughout San Diego to provide safe shelter, transitional housing, intervention prevention programs, mental health support, and many other services that meet the ever-changing needs of our communities.


Our organization is dedicated to offering high-quality services and ensuring all services align with the community's needs. To best serve our communities, SBCS partners with various grassroots organizations throughout California to develop innovative strategies that enhance services, empower clients, and ensure that culturally appropriate and trauma-informed care is offered. SBCS provides a wide range of services tailored to meet each client's unique needs. At SBCS, our client-centered approach highlights the importance of respect, empathy, and compassion when interacting with all community members.


About YOU

You are an advocate and champion of nurturing communities where families can pursue their dreams and fulfill their potential.


You are dedicated to and energized by engaging directly with individuals and communities.

You care deeply about the well-being and prosperity of ALL children and youth throughout San Diego.


You want to become a part of an energetic and effective team, and contribute your expertise, creativity, and insights to a unique role encompassing program management, development, and direct counseling services for at-risk children, adolescents, and families.


About our organization

SBCS is home to a committed team of 470 dedicated employees and volunteers who diligently serve all of San Diego County. Having offered services for 52 years, SBCS is committed to providing hope and support for numerous young children, individuals, and families facing adversity. With an annual budget of $68 million, SBCS continues to be a beacon of assistance in the community.


Competitive and Sustainable Employee Pay Package:

SBCS offers competitive pay and additional benefits for full-time employees, including generous vacation time, holidays, health, vision, dental, flexible spending accounts, an employee assistance program, discount programs, public service forgiveness loan, and an excellent retirement plan with matching contributions. Hybrid and remote schedules are available based on the program and job roles.


Program:

SBCS’ Community Assessment Team (CAT) & Juvenile Diversion (JD) program works to keep kids in school and out of the Juvenile Justice System by providing early intervention/prevention to youth and families. Embedded in the Youth Prevention & Intervention (YPI) Team, the program provides an array of support services for first-time youth offenders, runaways, youth on Probation, and non-offenders and their families.


RESPONSIBILITIES: The Youth Prevention & Intervention (YPI) Clinician will be responsible for providing trauma-informed mental health services to YPI youth and families enrolled in CAT and/or Juvenile Diversion programs. Under the supervision of the Program Manager & Department Director, the Clinician is responsible for crisis intervention, stabilization, and providing individual and group therapeutic services to youth and their families. Services will be in keeping with agency goals, objectives, mission, and style and provided within a team framework The YPI Clinician is responsible for working with the team in developing team goals and objectives and in meeting those goals and objectives, including but not limited to:


DUTIES:

  • Provide mental health assessments for identified youth, particularly those who may have experienced a mental health crisis and provide support to link family to appropriate mental health care.
  • Develop treatment plans including goals and objectives, in collaboration with other and other program staff.
  • Provide a range of culturally responsive, trauma-informed services to program clients that may include case management, individual and family counseling, group activities, wraparound services, and other services relative to program and team goals and objectives, including goals and objectives agreed upon with client.
  • Participate in training and implement various evidence-based therapeutic models, such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy and Trauma Affect Regulation: Guide to Education and Therapy (TARGET), to fidelity.
  • Participate in Multi-Disciplinary Team meetings with other YPI team members.
  • Transport clients in a safe and secure manner in matters related to service delivery.
  • Maintain case records and client files in the Efforts to Outcomes (ETO) database as required by SBCS and its funding sources.
  • Maintain monthly statistical reports of services provided as required by SBCS.
  • Outreach to target population to effectively reach those in need of services.
  • Participation in special projects and activities, as related to agency’s goals and objectives.
  • Identify Substance Use Disorder (SUD) treatment options for youth in need of higher-level of care.
  • Provide crisis intervention services, and referrals to telephone and walk in persons.
  • Participation and assistance in implementing program components.
  • Attends all agency required meetings and training.
  • As other duties assigned.

title: VIKARIERENDE BUTIKKLEDER PÅ ONLY KARL JOHAN
description:
Vil du bli med på reisen?

​

ONLY Stores er i sterk utvikling, og vi søker derfor en erfaren lederprofil som kan sikre en konstant utvikling av vår ONLY butikk på Karl Johan, i et vikariat på et år.

​

Bli en del av ONLY Stores

ONLY Stores har vært på en forrykende reise gjennom de siste fem år, og vi er langt fra ferdige med reisen. Vår forretningsplan har vist seg å være riktig. Vi har hatt vårt primærfokus på to ting – våre produkter og våre medarbeidere. Som en del av organisasjonen i ONLY Stores kan du i høy grad få det ansvaret du ønsker, de oppgaver du brenner for, og ikke minst være en del av et fantastisk team.

Hos ONLY Stores vet vi at våre medarbeidere gjør en stor forskjell!

​

Jobben

Som butikksjef har du ansvar for ledelsen og driften av butikken. Du vil jobbe med, og utvikle butikken i samarbeid med vår distriktssjef, og gjennom ditt solide nettverk sikrer du at ONLY er markedsledere i ditt nærområde. Du holder deg oppdatert på mote og trender og er opptatt av å følge med i markedet. Du liker å jobbe i et høyt tempo, er ikke redd for og ta i et tak og har et konkurranseinstinkt det lukter svidd av. Du leder ditt team til suksess gjennom å lede som et godt forbilde.

​

Konkret vil dine arbeidsoppgaver innebære:

· Utvikle medarbeidere via daglig oppfølging, trening og delegering

· Sikre rekruttering av det rette personalet med potensiale, energi og evne til å skape resultater

· Effektiv planlegging for deg og dine medarbeidere

· Daglig sparring med distriktsjef med fokus på omsetning og resultater

· Utvikling og optimering av butikkens uttrykk, vareplassering og effektivisering

· Utvikling og motivasjon av medarbeidere med fokus på å løfte kompetansenivået i forhold til salg og ledelse

· Lagerstyring og oppfølging av topplister

· Oppfølging av budsjetter og regnskap

Din profil

Du kjenner retailbransjen innenfra og du har en naturlig interesse for mote. Du er en person med høy grad av energi, har sans for detaljer, og du tør å sette retningen. Det er viktig at du er utadvendt i din arbeidsstil , og du er i stand til å skape et solid nettverk. Du er god på og skape team og øke kompetansen til de rundt deg.

​

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

​

Om oss

ONLY Stores er en del av BESTSELLER Retail Europe vi har eksisteret i mer enn 25 år og driver konseptbutikker under følgende brands: ONLY, ONLY & SONS & JDY.

Vi har base i Brande, hvor vi er 40 dedikerede kollegaer, som beskjeftiger oss med drift av butikker. Vi driver BESTSELLER Retail Europe ut fra ledelsesmessige verdier, som bygger på fremgang for enhver pris, nærhet til våre kollegaer og butikker og en uskuelig tro på, at vi kan gjøre det enda bedre i morgen.

Vi arbeider i et sterkt konkurransemessig miljø, hvor vår innsats og innstilling gir resultater direkte på bunnlinjen. Vi hyller prinsippet om frihet under ansvar, og vi elsker mennesker som tar initiativ og som gjør en forskjell. Vi tror på, at det er den måte vi best utvikler vår forretning og hverandre.

​

Job Description:

Deliver simple solutions to complex problems as a Solutions Architect at GDIT. Here, you’ll tailor cutting-edge solutions to the unique requirements of our clients. With a career in application development, you’ll make the end user’s experience your priority and we’ll make your career growth ours.

As a Solutions Architect SME you will help ensure today is safe and tomorrow is smarter. Our work depends on a growth-focused Solutions Architect SME joining our Federal Health team to lead solution development for Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) opportunities, with a focus on software development, application modernization, and DevSecOps. This is a growth role: most of your time will be spent working with capture and proposal teams to shape technical solutions and write proposal content. You will bring strong knowledge of government agencies, preferably VA, and the ability to translate customer needs, solicitation requirements, GDIT capabilities, delivery experience, and partner technologies into clear, compelling, and executable solutions. Experience in both growth and delivery is valuable, but prior delivery experience is not required.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT :

  • Lead technical solution development for growth opportunities, from early capture and shaping through proposal submission and oral presentations, as applicable.
  • Work as the technical lead within capture and proposal teams to develop an integrated solution aligned to customer requirements, win strategy, evaluation criteria, and GDIT capabilities.
  • Analyze RFIs, RFPs, performance work statements, statements of work, and other acquisition artifacts to identify technical requirements, solution gaps, risks, and differentiators.
  • Own and write technical proposal content, including solution narratives, architectures, delivery approaches, transition plans, technical management approaches, LOE/BOE and supporting graphics.

description:

Seattle University will be one of the most innovative and progressive Jesuit and Catholic universities in the world, educating with excellence at the undergraduate, graduate, and professional levels. We embrace an intersectional framework for defining diversity in its broadest sense, including differences in gender, gender identity, race, ethnicity, generational history, culture, socioeconomic class, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, political perspectives, geographic origin and physical ability. Seattle University strives to be a welcome, open and safe campus climate for all who learn, live and work at Seattle University.


Seattle University's Core Competencies


Effective Team Collaboration: Works harmoniously with others towards a common goal, leveraging individual strengths to achieve shared objectives.


Emotionally Intelligent Communication: Engages in a skillful exchange of information, thoughts, and feelings, verbally and non-verbally.


Ethics and Integrity: Demonstrates an unwavering commitment to honesty, professionalism, and alignment with our Jesuit mission in all actions and decisions.


Flexibility and Innovation: Embraces change, approaching problems with curiosity adaptability, and is committed to making a positive impact.


Mindful Inclusion: Fosters mindful inclusion by consciously creating a workplace that celebrates differences, embraces cultural humility, and empowers uniqueness.


Outcomes-Driven Orientation: Sets clear objectives, pursues excellence, and delivers measurable outcomes while upholding Jesuit Catholic values.


Job Description Summary

Assistant Dean for Academic Affairs & Student Success provides leadership and oversight for academic affairs, student recruitment, progression, retention, completion, academic program quality, and student success initiatives within the College of Nursing and Health Sciences.

Position Description:

Seattle University invites applications to fill a new Assistant Dean for Academic Affairs & Student Success position (12-month staff). We seek an enthusiastic, dynamic, thoughtful individual whose primary responsibilities are to lead and oversee activities related to academic affairs; student recruitment, progression, retention, and completion; and compliance with student-related policies, procedures, and expectations.

The Assistant Dean for Academic Affairs & Student Success must be committed to an executive leadership role that develops strategic ideas, makes organizational-level decisions, implements policies and procedures, and executes and evaluates initiatives that all contribute to student academic success and an overall positive student experience. They must be innovative, creative, collaborative, communicative, and transparent, valuing and encouraging the pursuits and contributions of a wide variety of faculty colleagues across multiple disciplines.

Seattle University College of Nursing and Health Sciences seeks individuals motivated to be part of a community-engaged, creative, and dynamic learning organization committed to social justice, teaching innovation, impactful research, and the formation of health professionals endeavoring to create a more humane world by meeting the health and healthcare needs of all people, especially those marginalized and underserved. We are looking to build a team that is inspired and committed to making a difference for the greater good of society, as Seattle University has a vision to be one of the most innovative and progressive Jesuit and Catholic universities in the world, educating with excellence at the undergraduate, graduate, and professional levels.

The College of Nursing and Health Sciences currently houses academic programs that lead to a Bachelor of Science in Nursing, a Doctor of Nursing Practice, a Bachelor of Science in Diagnostic Ultrasound, a Bachelor of Science in Kinesiology, and a Master of Science in Kinesiology; and is positioned for growth to offer academic training programs in other health-related disciplines and professions in line with the goals of Seattle University’s Reigniting Strategic Directions.

Seattle University, as a whole, continues to be strengthened by an increasingly diverse campus community spanning faculty, staff, and students. Seattle University’s LIFT SU, Inclusive Excellence Action Plan for Racial Equity and Antiracism, led by Seattle University’s Office of Diversity and Inclusion, has fostered meaningful change to assure that people from underrepresented and historically marginalized groups feel a true sense of belonging and value. Aside from racial identity, people with lived experience across all intersectional identities and faiths or non-faiths add to the vibrancy of our campus environment and welcoming institutional climate.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Serve as principal liaison to academic affairs-related University-level units (e.g., Office of the Registrar, Office of the Provost, Graduate Studies) to represent the College’s academic program and curricular interests, including the execution of academically relevant policies and procedures.
  • Oversee the exploration and development of new academic programs, including coordinating and assisting on workflows that take ideas throughout all stages/phases of the proposal process.
  • Collaborate with academic program leaders throughout the College, Dean’s Office, and University to monitor, evaluate, and uphold academic program quality in alignment with University, College, and external accreditation and regulatory expectations and standards.
  • Partner with campus units to organize and carry out student recruitment and admissions strategies, initiatives, and events with oversight of coordinating the College’s activities and participation.
  • Liaise with professional student advisors, faculty advisors, and University units/groups to develop and implement actions that facilitate robust student matriculation, progression, support, persistence, completion, and graduation while promoting positive student experiences and overall student welfare.
  • Facilitate student awareness and access to programs and services focused on student success and campus life.
  • Oversee and support student extracurricular activities and opportunities, including College-related student governance bodies, clubs, and organizations.
  • Promote and pursue opportunities for recognizing and highlighting student and academic programming excellence.
  • Manage and monitor, in partnership with other College administrators, student matters related to academic performance and standing, conduct, and well-being; including serving in a student advocacy role, as appropriate and when warranted.
  • Assist other College senior administrators (e.g., Dean, Assistant Dean for Accreditation and Regulatory Compliance, academic area leads) with tasks related to monitoring, documenting, and reporting indicators for academic program health and student-related outcomes to assure compliance with accreditation standards and regulatory requirements.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Earned graduate degree, preferably in a health-related field, from an accredited higher education institution.
  • Demonstrated successful leadership experience in academic administration in higher education.
  • Track record of program/project development, assessment, and continuous quality improvement.
  • Experience with program evaluation processes.
  • Commitment to promoting excellence, diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in an institution of higher education.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, including faculty, staff, students, alumni, and external partners.
  • Understanding of current trends, issues, and best practices in higher education.
  • Excellent written and oral communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
  • Preferred Qualifications
  • If the applicant is a licensed healthcare professional, their license and/or certification must be current and unrestricted, and they must be eligible for licensure and/or certification in Washington state.
  • Experience in student advising, development, and mentorship in an institution of higher education.
  • Experience with grant writing and securing external funding for educational and training initiatives.

Applicants

Candidates must demonstrate a commitment to Seattle University's and the College of Nursing and Health Sciences' mission, vision, and values. The College emphasizes care of communities and populations that are underserved and marginalized. In concert with our Jesuit tradition, we are dedicated to social justice and leadership formation. Our faculty employ best practices and innovative approaches to graduating the highest quality health professionals at both the undergraduate and doctoral levels. Nationally respected health and research institutions in the Western Washington and Pacific Northwest region offer opportunities for collaboration, and Seattle University faculty, staff, and students are eager to engage in interdisciplinary endeavors.

Compensation at a Glance

$90,000 – $92,000

Your total compensation goes beyond the number on your paycheck. Seattle University provides generous leave, health plans, and retirement contributions that add to your total compensation package.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Clayton, Missouri.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Clayton area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Clayton requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

description:
Job Description

The Chemical Commercialization Technology (CCT) department, which is part of our Manufacturing Division, is seeking self-motivated individuals who are looking for an opportunity to work in a highly collaborative environment that provides substantial technical responsibility and leadership of internal and external work.

The Assoc. Scientist, Engineering position leverages scientific/technical experience to develop safe and robust processes through process characterization, tech transfer, validation, filing and supply support. The incumbent is expected to provide scientific expertise in small molecule active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) process characterization work by learning and utilizing Quality Risk Management methodologies and tools for statistical design of experiments. This role involves hands-on wet chemistry experimentation at the laboratory bench and kilo lab scales in addition to technology transfer to commercial manufacturing facilities. Approximately 10-20% travel time is expected. The scientist will be expected to exhibit a mindset of safety and quality compliance, which will include following current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs), and participating in risk assessments, deviation investigations, and Good Documentation Practices (GDPs).

  • Strong understanding of chemistry and/or chemical engineering fundamental concepts
  • Desire to learn and engage in process scale-up and technology transfer, moving from laboratory to pilot plant or factory scale
  • Desire to perform both laboratory experimentation and on-site support of scale-up activities and manufacturing operations
  • Ability to work in the laboratories at the Rahway, New Jersey site with occasional domestic and international travel, as necessary. This is primarily a laboratory-based roll and onsite presence is required.
  • Strong organizational, interpersonal, writing, and time management skills

Preferred Experience and Skills:

  • Proven ability to work independently and collaborate effectively as part of a team
  • Experience with process development in a laboratory, pilot-scale, or manufacturing environment
  • Experience with developing and executing an experimental program to address issues with process design, robustness, or productivity for an existing product/process
  • Familiarity with statistical design and analysis tools
  • Familiarity with concepts and application of current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs) ideally during pharmaceutical drug substance / drug product development and production, e.g. in a pilot and/or factory setting. #EBRG's #VetJobs #FTP2027

Required Skills:

Chemical Engineering, Data Analysis, Design of Experiments (DOE), Experimental Methods, Experimentation, Good Lab Practices, Maintenance Supervision, Pharmaceutical Process Development, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Process Design, Process Development (PD), Process Engineering, Process Improvements, Process Scale Up, Process Transfers, Product Transfers, Statistical Data Analysis, Technical Writing, Technology Transfer, Wet Chemistry, Writing Technical Documents

Det er primært til vores Ford- og Hyundai-team, at vi har brug for ekstra hænder, men vi er snart også autoriseret værksted for Zeekr, og det kan også være en mulighed at være med til at starte det op.

  • Reparation og vedligeholdelse af personbiler

Du er uddannet mekaniker/tekniker og vil gerne specialisere dig i et af vores mærker, og vi giver dig gerne den rette oplæring.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har en sund nysgerrighed for biler og teknikken i biler og gerne med elbiler som dit fokusområde
  • Er god med en computer, da den er et vigtigt værktøj for en tekniker i dag
  • Har et godt humør og er god til at samarbejde
  • Har lyst til løbende at udvikle dig og lære nyt

Det tilbyder vi

  • Løbende uddannelse via kurser og webtræning hos importører eller andre udbydere
  • Gode kolleger
  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø på et nyrenoveret og moderne værksted

Stillingen på 37 timer, løn efter kvalifikationer og tiltrædelse snarest muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette.

Nielsen Car Group, som er blandt Danmarks største bilkoncerner. Med øvrige brands som Bjarne Nielsen, LEASING DK, Motorpoint, Bilernes Hus samt værksteder er der mange muligheder i koncernen for den rette. Vi har en moderne ledelse, som sætter pris på medarbejdere, der tager initiativ og ansvar, og du kan i høj grad præge din hverdag.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så klik på ”Send ansøgning” her på siden og send din ansøgning og CV. Vi holder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Eftermarkedschef Jesper Kjeldsen på tlf. 2988 2826 eller jejk@bn.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Om os

Nielsen Car Group A/S er en af Danmarks største bilkoncerner. Tilsammen er vi mere end 900 medarbejdere fordelt blandt vores bilhuse under brands som Bjarne Nielsen, Dahl Pedersen, Bilernes Hus i Silkeborg samt leasingfirmaet LEASING DK. Vi er autoriseret forhandler af bilmærkerne Alpine, Ford, Volvo, Hyundai, Zeekr, Polestar, Mazda, Renault, Dacia, Nissan, Omoda og Jaecoo - og vi har derudover autoriseret service af Audi, BMW, Skoda, Seat, Kia, Cupra og Volkswagen.

Vi har mere end 35 års erfaring som forhandler af nye og brugte personbiler og varevogne til private og erhvervslivet. Vi lever af glade kunder, og vi brænder for at gøre en forskel, så vores kunder aldrig er i tvivl om, hvor de skal købe deres næste bil. Samtidig skal Nielsen Car Group altid være det naturlige valg, når det gælder service og reparation. Det betyder også, at vi går "det ekstra skridt" for at yde professionel rådgivning i særklasse, så vi kan sikre den ultimative kundeoplevelse.

title: Data Enablement Engineer
description:
Do you enjoy helping engineers and analysts succeed with modern data platforms while staying hands-on with technology?

About The Role

We are looking for a Data Platform Engineer to help teams adopt and enable If’s strategic data platform built on Azure, Databricks, dbt, Git, and CI/CD. You will work directly with users during their first implementations, help solve technical challenges, and turn recurring lessons into reusable onboarding assets, templates, and best practices.

Your success is measured not only by successful onboarding, but by how quickly teams can deliver business value using the platform. By reducing friction, accelerating adoption, and promoting proven ways of working, you help data teams spend less time figuring out the platform and more time creating value for customers and the business.

You Will

  • Guide teams through onboarding and their first implementations on Databricks and modern data engineering tools.
  • Provide hands‑on support and knowledge sharing with Databricks, DBT, Git, CI/CD, and platform ways of working.
  • Help teams move faster from idea to production by removing technical and process‑related obstacles.
  • Help create or support the creation of reusable assets such as templates, examples, training material, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Guide engineers, analysts, and other data practitioners to become productive faster.
  • Identify recurring challenges and translate them into improved onboarding, documentation, or platform practices.
  • Drive platform adoption that enables teams to deliver business outcomes more efficiently and consistently.

We offer

Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

  • An including work environment where everyone is welcome
  • Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
  • Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
  • Possibilityofhybridworkplace
  • Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance
  • Greatinsurancebenefits

It is a blend of technical work with day‑to‑day user communication and support, so you get to know a lot of colleagues across the organization.

Who are you?

You have a strong technical background in data engineering, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, or a similar field. You enjoy working closely with both technical teams and business stakeholders, helping others succeed while driving adoption, productivity, and value creation. You are a strong communicator who can clearly explain complex topics and thrive in a collaborative and agile environment.

title: Pre-Construction Admin (PCA)
description:
Harmony is on a mission to be the best life safety partner to work with and for. Rated an ‘Outstanding Employer’ by Best Companies in 2025, we are only getting bigger and stronger — and we’re looking for A-players to help us get there.

We are passionate about making a difference and obsessed with quality. Our goal is to build a world where every resident can sleep safely at night, knowing their home is 100% safe.

We are now hiring a Pre-Construction Assistant to join our growing West Midlands pod, reporting to the Pre-Construction Director. This is a process control role, not a clerical one. You will own document control, stage readiness, evidence completeness and the operational rhythm of the pod — the engine room that keeps PCMs, estimators and surveyors focused on the work that wins and delivers projects.

A good Pre-Construction Assistant keeps the pod running smoothly. A great one makes everyone around them better at their job. This is more than just an admin role: it is about bringing the right energy, accountability and resilience to our mission of saving lives through fire and height safety.

• Own document control across the pod’s projects — folder structure, naming conventions, version control and filing standards.

• Administer the PCI pack process: track completeness, chase missing evidence and flag gaps before they hold up handover into delivery.

• Manage pod scheduling, meeting coordination and action tracking — keeping the operational rhythm tight so PCMs and the PCD spend time on commercial decisions, not chasing logistics.

• Maintain accurate records in Salesforce, SimPRO and SharePoint, ensuring data is current, clean and consistent across all pod projects.

• Coordinate client communications — formatting weekly client reports to standard, supporting resident liaison processes and managing correspondence templates.

• Support the wider pod with onboarding admin for new starters, ensuring the universal Day 1 checklist is delivered without gaps.

• Track outstanding items across live projects, surfacing risks early so the PCD and PCMs can act before they become problems.

• Contribute to continuous improvement across pod processes — sharing what’s working, flagging what isn’t.

• An A-player mindset — high standards, extreme ownership and the drive to do things properly, the first time.

• Proven experience in a coordination, project administration or operations role, ideally within construction, fire safety, building services or a closely related sector.

• Extremely detail-oriented — the kind of person who spots the missing document, the broken folder structure and the unanswered email before anyone else does.

• Exceptionally organised, with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities and projects without dropping threads.

• A genuine can-do attitude — no job is too small, no problem is someone else’s to solve.

• Confident communicator, both written and verbal, comfortable being the point of contact for clients, residents, suppliers and the wider team.

• Highly proficient with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams, SharePoint) and able to pick up new systems quickly — Salesforce, SimPRO and similar.

• Process-minded — sees admin as control, not paperwork, and gets satisfaction from systems that run cleanly.

• Based within commutable distance of our West Midlands office.

This is a chance to be the engine room of one of Harmony’s pre-construction pods at one of the UK’s fastest-growing safety specialists — the person who keeps the operation tight and makes everyone around them better at their job. At Harmony, we ask a lot — and we give a lot back. The hours are real, the standards are high and the work is demanding, but for those who show up, deliver and go the extra mile, the rewards follow. A-players here enjoy a competitive salary, a Personal Development Plan with ongoing training and mentoring, unlimited holiday, a bonus scheme paying up to 50% of annual salary, enhanced maternity and paternity, lunch, snacks and refreshments on us every day (fresh fruit and Takeaway Friday included), a team social budget, an auto-enrolment pension, two major company events a year and our Reward and Recognition scheme — including European mini-breaks for those who go above and beyond. It is a collaborative, high-energy environment focused on doing things the right way — and none of it is a perk for showing up; it’s what we share with the people pulling the business forward.


Harmony is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants for employment regardless of age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief. We want everyone who works with us to feel valued and to make a difference.

title: HUMANITARIAN AFFAIRS ADVISOR
description:
Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent medical humanitarian organization. As a non-profit, self-governed movement of over 63,000 dedicated professionals, we provide life-saving medical assistance to people affected by armed conflict, natural disasters, disease outbreaks, and exclusion from healthcare.

Our work is guided by medical ethics and the principles of impartiality, independence, and neutrality. We act based on need, and when we witness injustice, we speak out. Our commitment to professionalism and humanity can mean the difference between life and death.

People are our priority. At Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF)/ Artsen zonder Grenzen, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We encourage diverse applicants including individuals of all gender identities, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, ethnic background, religions, beliefs, social and marital status, people with different abilities and all other diversity characteristics and how they intersect together.

With immediate effect, MSF OCA is looking for an:

Humanitarian Affairs Advisor Maternity Cover (32 hours) 80% with (20%) travelling to country programmes

Preferred location Amsterdam, possible other locations: London, Berlin, Amman and Nairobi

OSCAR is OCA’s humanitarian affairs, operational communications and advocacy department. It is comprised of Communication Advisors (CAs), Audio-Visual, (AV), Digital Producers and Humanitarian Affairs Advisors (HAAs) who work in tandem in distinct and complementary roles.

Témoignage’, understood as bearing witness to, speaking out against and denouncing dehumanising instances, such as those of injustice, violence, armed conflict, as well as discriminatory and exclusionary policies, is at the core of MSF’s mission. Guided by this commitment, OSCAR teams prioritise the countering and monitoring of policies, narratives and actions that infringe upon people’s dignities and subject them to systemic dehumanisation. We focus on responding to emergencies, on engaging and influencing key stakeholders through témoignage-based advocacy, and on producing and developing powerful public communications that places agency and respect to the communities we aim to assist at its core.

OSCAR’s Humanitarian Affairs team, coordinated by the Humanitarian Affairs Coordinator (HACo), comprises Humanitarian Affairs Advisors (HAA) with expertise in a wide range of fields, including on international relations, access negotiations, international humanitarian & human rights law, forced migration, and health policy & systems.

OSCAR's Operational Communications team, coordinated by the Communications Coordinator (CoCo), includes communication advisors, a mis/disinformation advisor and staff with specialised digital and audiovisual skills who facilitate MSF's communication and témoignage on behalf of OCA's operations.

OSCAR works in close proximity with desks and country-based staff to support country teams in better understanding and addressing some of the challenges of the communities we work with, and best leveraging the potential of our proximity to affected populations to bear witness and speak out in support of the communities that we aim to assist and stand in solidarity with.

Objective

In this role, you are a key advisor on humanitarian affairs, analysis and advocacy across selected MSF OCA country programmes and humanitarian themes. You help MSF teams understand complex humanitarian dynamics, navigate positioning dilemmas and identify opportunities to improve the situation of affected communities and strengthen the quality and impact of our operations and témoignage. Working at both country and organizational level, you provide strategic advice, develop humanitarian analysis and advocacy plans, and support teams to translate analysis into meaningful action and positioning. You will also contribute to organizational learning, capacity building and strategic decision-making on humanitarian affairs and advocacy.

Main responsibilities

  • Provide strategic advice, support and coaching to country teams on humanitarian affairs, analysis, advocacy and positioning across your assigned portfolio of countries and humanitarian themes.
  • Monitor and analyze political, social, humanitarian and operational dynamics in the contexts where MSF is working, identifying key developments, risks and opportunities.
  • Support country teams and management in addressing complex positioning issues and dilemmas, providing clear analysis and practical recommendations.
  • Develop and support the implementation of humanitarian analysis and advocacy plans, including work with external actors and partners.
  • Produce, contribute to and/or edit high-quality internal and external briefing papers, reports, analyses and positioning documents.
  • Advise country management teams and HQ operations, medical managers and advisors on humanitarian affairs and advocacy matters.
  • Technically supervise and coach country-level humanitarian affairs staff, helping strengthen their capacity and practice.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of training on humanitarian affairs, advocacy and positioning for country and HQ teams.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of OCA policies, strategies, procedures, tools and guidelines related to humanitarian affairs and advocacy.
  • Work closely with country leadership, Operations, Public Health, other OCA departments and MSF sections to build alignment on humanitarian affairs and advocacy issues.
  • Build and maintain networks with relevant external stakeholders, including NGOs, and represent MSF in external meetings and forums when required.
  • Contribute to organizational strategic decision-making, including through the Control Cycle.
  • Visit MSF teams and projects in countries of operation as required.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for an experienced humanitarian affairs professional who combines strong analytical and strategic thinking with the ability to advise, influence and collaborate across different levels of an international organization.

You bring:

  • A Master’s degree in law, social sciences, political sciences or another relevant field.
  • At least 7 years of professional experience in humanitarian affairs
  • MSF experience in Humanitarian Affairs is Essential
  • In-depth knowledge of the factors influencing humanitarian affairs in contexts where MSF operates
  • Strong experience in humanitarian analysis, advocacy and positioning
  • The ability to analyse complex situations, identify key issues and translate analysis into clear recommendations and action.
  • Experience advising and coaching colleagues and working effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt complex analysis for different audiences.
  • Fluency in English and another relevant language; languages spoken in MSF countries of operation are highly desirable.
  • The ability and willingness to work across different contexts and travel to MSF projects and teams when needed.

Core Competencies:

  • Strategic and analytical thinking
  • Influencing and advising
  • Collaboration and stakeholder engagement
  • Communication and advocacy
  • Coaching and capacity building
  • Adaptability and working effectively in complex humanitarian contexts

We offer

An employment contract is based on 32 hours per week. It is a one-year Maternity Cover. Compensation package and benefits will depend on the country of domicile and the local labor law.

In addition, you can expect:

  • L&D will support you with a variety of learning and development opportunities with internal and external training and courses
  • An environment that fosters diversity, with colleagues from around the world representing various cultures and backgrounds

Application

For this position, we have a preference for candidates who are currently based in locations where MSF has an established contracting office, as the position does not include relocation support.

Are you excited about the opportunity to contribute to this role and make a meaningful difference through your experience and expertise? We would be very happy to hear from you!

To apply, please upload one combined document containing your motivation letter and Curriculum Vitae (CV), in English. Please note that only applications including a motivation letter will be considered.

The recruitment process will include one interview round, a test or other assessment may also be included. Application deadline: 27th September 2026, 23:59 CET.

Information

Would you like to learn more about the position or have questions before applying?

For further information about the position and its responsibilities, please contact: Louise Roland-Gosselin Muamba Humanitarian Affairs Coordinator
louise.roland-gosselin@nairobi.msf.org

For questions regarding the recruitment process, terms and conditions, or MSF, please contact: Imad Al-Fadel imad.al-fadel@amman.msf.org

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Gibsonia, Pennsylvania.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Gibsonia area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Gibsonia requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Forretningscontroller
description:
Om Tide

Tide er en av Norges største aktører innen kollektivtransport, med en tydelig visjon om å levere trygg, effektiv og miljøvennlig transport. Vi har et sterkt fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhet og bærekraft, og våre medarbeidere er nøkkelen til å lykkes. Hos oss blir du en del av et inkluderende og fremtidsrettet arbeidsmiljø.

Om stillingen

Som forretningscontroller med hovedansvar for vår turbussvirksomhet blir du en del av controllerteamet i Tide Horisont og du vil jobbe med hele forretningsspekteret; fra salg og topplinje til kostnadsoppfølging og lønnsomhetsfokus som skaper bunnlinje. Du vil få mye ansvar og en bratt læringskurve, kombinert med tett oppfølging. Sammen skaper vi muligheter for både faglig og personlig utvikling. Vi ønsker å legge til rette for en fleksibel hverdag der frihet under ansvar legges til grunn. Du vil være tett på alle prosessene i turbussvirksomheten vår – og den er mer kompleks enn man kanskje skulle tro! Vi ser derfor etter en kandidat som ikke bare ser tallene, men også hva som ligger bak dem.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Budsjettering og prognoser

  • Perioderapportering og årsoppgjør

  • Lønnsomhetsanalyser og investeringskalkyler

  • Prosjektoppfølging

Kvalifikasjoner

  • økonomisk bakgrunn, fortrinnsvis på masternivå (erfaring og kompetanse kan kompensere for manglende formell utdanning)

  • sterke kommunikasjonsevner og skjønner at det er menneskene som skaper resultater

  • gode Excel-kunnskaper. Teknologikompetanse innenfor PowerBI, koding eller AI er et klart pluss

Personlige egenskaper

  • Analytisk og forretningsorientert

  • Selvstendig og strukturert

  • Evner å håndtere flere oppgaver samtidig og utfordre etablerte arbeidsmåter

Vi tilbyr

  • En sentral rolle med stor påvirkningskraft i en virksomhet som bidrar direkte til det grønne skiftet.

  • Mye ansvar, en bratt læringskurve og tett oppfølging.

  • Fleksibilitet i hverdagen og frihet under ansvar, med mulighet for hjemmekontor.

  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling.

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med en kultur for å spille hverandre gode og gi konstruktive tilbakemeldinger.

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser samt gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

  • Velferdslag med aktiviteter og firmahytter.
