Er du social- eller sundhedsfaglig uddannet? Vil du arbejde med borgere med psykiske problemstillinger med forskellig grad af kompleksitet og på et botilbud med høj grad af brugerindflydelse og inddragelse. Så kig med her.

Botilbud Stubberupgård er et specialiseret § 108 botilbud for voksne sindslidende. Stubberupgård har til huse på en herregård i naturskønne omgivelser. Botilbuddet rummer 44 boliger til borgere i alderen fra 28 år og opefter, alle med behov for længerevarende støtte, omsorg og hjælp til personlig og social udvikling.

Vores botilbud er opdelt i fire boenheder, og vi har en beskæftigelsesafdeling, hvor vi tilbyder borgerne værksted, dyrehold og grøn omsorg; med fokus på, hvad samspillet med naturen gør ved os.

Vi har oparbejdet en særlig kultur med fokus på aktiviteter, udeliv og sanseintegration og fællesskaber. Derudover har Stubberupgård gennemgået en gennemgribende ombygning og fremstår nu fuldt moderniseret.

Botilbuddet ligger ved Borup på Midtsjælland, og hører under Center for længerevarende Botilbud i Socialforvaltningen i Københavns Kommune.

Om stillingen
Stillingen er med en ugentlig arbejdstid på 37 timer i skiftende vagter med dag- og aftenvagter med arbejdsweekend hver 3. uge og arbejdstid i tidsrummet mellem kl. 06.30 – 23.00. Der vil kunne forekomme enkelte nattevagter.

Vi arbejder i teams med kontaktpersonsordning og har fokus på arbejdsfællesskaber. Vi arbejder rehabiliterende, så det vil være en fordel, hvis du har viden om og erfaring med LA2, kognitiv miljøterapi, recovery og MI.

Vi leder efter dig, der

  • er uddannet SSA, pædagog, ergoterapeut eller sygeplejerske
  • brænder for relationsarbejde
  • er vant til at dokumentere i fagsystemer
  • kan begå dig i et fagligt miljø med stor omskiftelighed, og hvor kerneopgaven er beboernes udvikling og trivsel
  • har kompetencer inden for medicinhåndtering og er interesseret i at bruge og udvikle denne viden
  • ser muligheder i arbejdet med borgerne og er i stand til at understøtte borgernes individuelle recoveryproces
  • er teamplayer og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet og samarbejdet, er pligtopfyldende, stabil og er åben for sparring og feedback
  • er fleksibel i forhold til at arbejde i skiftende vagter og kan tænke kreativt, selvstændigt og selv tør stå til ansvar for dine faglige beslutninger
  • er initiativrig, nysgerrig og innovativ
Arbejdsopgaver

  • arbejde pædagogisk ud fra de mål, som er fastsat for indsatsen med borgeren i centrum
  • medicinhåndtering
  • dokumentation og handleplaner
  • pårørendesamarbejde
  • hjælp til personlig pleje
  • samarbejde med interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere
  • understøtte borgeren i aktiviteter og beskæftigelse
Vi tilbyder
På Stubberupgård vil du få et selvstændigt job med indflydelse på, og ansvar for at udvikle og tilrettelægge egne opgaver. Du vil møde et spændende arbejdsmiljø med masser af faglige udfordringer, supervision og mulighed for at deltage i undervisning.

Vi er et botilbud med høj brugerindflydelse og -inddragelse. Vi arbejder ud fra Københavns Kommunes værdigrundlag og ser samarbejde som nøglen til positiv gensidig udvikling. Kort sagt er vi et botilbud i udvikling med engagerede medarbejdere og beboere.

Ansættelsesforhold
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst og principperne i Ny Løn. Der er tale om fast stilling, og der er tiltrædelse den 1. november 2026 eller gerne snarest herefter.

Sammen med din ansøgning beder vi dig uploade din dokumentation for gennemført uddannelse og CV. I forbindelse med ansættelse vil vi indhente straffeattest og reference.

Mere information
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte botilbudsleder Søs Sabransky på 26 86 10 01 eller afdelingsleder Mikkel Faarvang Kirkeskov på 24 85 16 84.

Du kan også få et indtryk af os og vores beboere i filmen her: https://youtu.be/pzPJD6T5KLQ

Du kan også læse mere om os på vores hjemmeside

Søg via linket senest søndag den 27. september 2026
Vi holder ansættelsessamtaler løbende.

title: Student Commercial Analyst, Projects
description:
Earlier this year, building on the solid foundation of Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) as a fund manager, we introduced an optimized CIP Platform, with three platform companies providing services to CIP. To learn more, please refer to the CIP Platform section below.

In our optimized CIP Platform, CIP Terra Technologies – a project delivery company delivering projects from onshore wind, solar PV and battery energy storage systems, to bioenergy, thermal and transmission infrastructure – is currently looking for Commercial Analyst to join the team in Melbourne, Australia.

Team

The chosen candidate will become part of the growing CIPTT team with offices across Melbourne, Newcastle, Sydney & Brisbane. Regular travel between offices may be required. The team currently consists of ~25 employees with renewable energy backgrounds. The CIPTT team in Australia is delivering some of the largest renewable energy projects in Australia across BESS, onshore wind and pumped hydro.

Role

We are seeking a Part-Time Commercial Analyst to support the commercial team across CIPTT's Australian portfolio of renewable energy projects. This role is intended for a university student currently undertaking a relevant degree and looking to gain practical experience alongside their studies. The role reports to the Commercial Director and preferably based in Melbourne, although Sydney, Brisbane or Newcastle will also be considered.

The Commercial Analyst will support the commercial development, governance and reporting of projects from inception through development, financial close and into operations. Working closely with development, engineering, procurement, legal and commercial teams, the role will be responsible for coordinating inputs across project workstreams, tracking key milestones and risks, and preparing high-quality reporting for CIP's governance and investment decision-making processes.

The ideal candidate will play an important role in ensuring project status, risks, opportunities and key decisions are clearly captured and communicated to internal stakeholders. The role offers exposure to all stages of the project lifecycle and the opportunity to work across a diverse portfolio of large-scale renewable energy projects.

Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

The Commercial Analyst will provide broad support to the commercial team across CIPTT's Australian renewable energy portfolio. Working closely with development, technical, engineering, procurement and commercial stakeholders, the role will help coordinate project activities, maintain governance and reporting processes, and ensure key project information is accurately captured and communicated. The position offers exposure across the full project lifecycle and plays an important role in supporting effective decision-making, project delivery and portfolio management. The responsibilities include:

  • Support the commercial development and management of CIPTT's portfolio of renewable energy projects.
  • Coordinate inputs across development, technical, engineering, procurement and commercial workstreams to support project delivery and decision-making.
  • Prepare high-quality project reporting, presentations and governance materials for internal management, investment committees and other stakeholders.
  • Track key project milestones, risks, opportunities, decisions and action items, maintaining accurate project reporting and documentation.
  • Assist in the preparation and review of project budgets, schedules, commercial evaluations and business case materials.
  • Support procurement and contracting activities, including maintaining contract registers, tracking obligations and coordinating stakeholder inputs.
  • Support governance processes by preparing meeting materials and documenting outcomes and actions.
  • Maintain project data rooms, reporting tools and document management systems to ensure information remains accurate, current and accessible.
  • Support the management of external advisors, consultants and counterparties by coordinating information requests, deliverables and reporting requirements.
  • Monitor project performance indicators and prepare concise summaries of project progress, key issues and recommended actions.
  • Work collaboratively across the CIPTT team to identify process improvements and promote consistency in reporting, governance and project controls across the portfolio.
  • Undertake commercial analysis and research to support strategic initiatives, market assessments and project development activities as required.

You

We are looking for a motivated and well-rounded individual who is currently completing, or has recently completed, a relevant university degree. Prior internship, vacation program, part-time within renewable energy, infrastructure, consulting, engineering, construction, or a related commercial environment. The selected candidate will be highly organised, detail-oriented, and keen to learn, with strong communication skills and a genuine interest in supporting the development of large-scale renewable energy projects.

We look for the following in a candidate:

  • Relevant tertiary studies in Commerce, Business, Economics, Engineering, Project Management or a related discipline.
  • Effective organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and stakeholder inputs.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly PowerPoint, Excel and Word.
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear, concise reports and presentations.
  • Solid attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.
  • Demonstrated structured and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify key issues and communicate findings effectively.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly PowerPoint, Excel and Word.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision, manage assigned tasks and consistently deliver outcomes.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build effective working relationships across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A collaborative mindset, strong work ethic and willingness to learn.
  • An interest in renewable energy, infrastructure and the energy transition.


The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.


As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.


Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.


---

CIP Terra Technologies’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Terra Technologies is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.


A diverse workforce allows CIP Terra Technologies to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, and ethnicity.


About CIP Terra Technologies

CIP Terra Technologies is a project delivery company working for CIP. CIP Terra Technologies is majority owned by the funds managed by CIP, with the purpose of delivering best-in-class project development and execution services to the growing portfolio of land-based renewable energy assets.


We engage in the energy transition through specialist project delivery, value creation, and collaboration with trusted third-party suppliers. Our core focus is the development, procurement, construction, and delivery of renewable energy projects, and we provide a variety of services including technical development, engineering, supply chain, construction management, and project execution.


We provide global support and a local presence in our key markets, and our teams are continuously delivering and refining services tailored to a wide range of technologies – from onshore wind, solar PV and battery energy storage systems, to bioenergy, thermal and transmission infrastructure. For more information, please visit CIP Terra Technologies.


Optimized CIP Platform

Earlier this year, we introduced an optimized CIP Platform. With three platform companies providing services to CIP—and while maintaining our current relationship with Copenhagen Offshore Partners (COP), CIP’s exclusive offshore wind development partner—we have effectively strengthened our organizational and operational capabilities, creating a platform scaled for growth and designing the CIP blueprint for the future.


We have established CIP Molecule Technologies, a tech-focused project delivery company dedicated to molecule projects; CIP Terra Technologies, a tech-focused project delivery company managing a diverse portfolio of onshore projects; and CIP Fund Solutions, a delivery company with expertise in complex fund management and investment services. For more info on this, please see: Optimized CIP Platform.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in San Marcos, California.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the San Marcos area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near San Marcos requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

description:

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Join Northrop Grumman on our continued mission to push the boundaries of possible across land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace. Enjoy a culture where your voice is valued and start contributing to our team of passionate professionals providing real-life solutions to our world’s biggest challenges. We take pride in creating purposeful work and allowing our employees to grow and achieve their goals every day by Defining Possible. With our competitive pay and comprehensive benefits, we have the right opportunities to fit your life and launch your career today.

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems currently has an opening for a Principal Systems Engineer. This position is located in Clearfield, UT and will support ICBM – Sustainment.

What you will get to do:

As a member of the ICBM-S assessment team, you will get to:

  • Develop innovative approaches to analyzing weapon system data with statistics and data analysis to help sustain and maintain the Minuteman III (MMIII) weapon system
  • Analyze failure and performance data across ICBM subsystems
  • Develop engaging visualizations and reports to show MMIII data trends and results
  • Prepare presentations and reports to brief Northrop Grumman and Air Force leadership on the status of weapon system assessment and risks
  • Participate and lead risk management of weapon system parts and subsystems
  • Dynamically engage with AF customers to meet their needs and provide them with needed insight for sustainment of the ICBM weapon system

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 5 years of experience; 3 years of experience with a Masters’ degree in STEM; or 1 year of experience with a PhD.
  • Must be a US Citizen with the ability to obtain a DoD Secret Clearance with an investigation date within the last 6 years.
  • Must be able to be successfully screened for Enhanced Security Clearances, within a reasonable amount of time as determined by the company to meet its business needs
  • 2 years of hands-on experience with data analytics, automation, or coding (e.g., Python, R, or similar)
  • 1 year of experience using advanced data analytics tools and techniques to provide insight into complex system or weapon-system conditions
  • 1 year of experience designing, implementing, and using data models to create reports and visualizations for large data sets
  • 1 year of experience analyzing data trends, identifying patterns, and developing predictive or statistical models to support project performance metrics, risk management, and process improvement initiatives, and to ensure compliance with government regulations and contract requirements
  • 2 years of experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar)
  • 2 years of experience working with large, complex, or multi-source datasets

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active DoD Secret clearance
  • Experience working with DoD or Air Force customers
  • Experience collaborating directly with program managers, engineers, and government stakeholders to define data requirements and reporting solutions
  • Experience working with and designing relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle) and data pipelines/ETL processes
  • Experience building dashboards and data visualizations for leadership decision-making
  • Experience applying statistical methods or machine learning techniques to develop predictive models
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to present complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to ensure data quality and integrity (e.g., data validation, reconciliation, QA processes)

As a full-time employee of Northrop Grumman Space Systems, you are eligible for our robust benefits package including:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • 401k
  • Educational Assistance
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programs & Work/Life Solutions
  • Paid Time Off
  • Health & Wellness Resources
  • Employee Discounts

This position's standard work schedule is 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off. This role may offer a competitive relocation assistance package.

Primary Level Salary Range: $98,400.00 - $147,600.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Ridgewood, New Jersey.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Ridgewood area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Ridgewood requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

description:
Within the SpiraTec Group, SpiraTec Solutions Inc. is the specialist for automation and IT solutions in the process industry in North America. With locations in California, Arizona, Ohio, nad North Carolina, we support comanies in the (bio)pharmaceutical, chemical, and petrochemical industries in the digital transformation of their production processes. As part of al global company, we combine international engineering expertise with local implementation skills - creating ideal conditions for your personal developement in an innovative enviroment.

Become part of the SpiraTec success story and actively contribute to the establishment of our team at Raleigh, North Carolina location. We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our team for Operational Technology (OT) in manufacturing. In this hybrid postion, you will work with our local and international team to deliver top-quality projects to our customers in the Pharmaceutical Manufacturing environment.

What are your responsibilities
  • You are responsible for the project management of industrial OT projects in the manufacturing environment for customers in the Pharmaceutical, Biotech, or Life Sciences industries.
  • You develop and maintain current client relationships as well as identify and acquire new potential clients.

What awaits you at SpiraTec
  • Be part of a future-oriented company and implement innovative solutions with us based on the latest technologies and approaches (digitalization, Industry 4.0).

Job Description:

SAP Project Manager

Contribute to the success of key project initiatives and support meaningful mission outcomes as an SAP Project Manager at GDIT. In this role, you’ll help drive high‑quality results for critical government programs.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

As an SAP Project Manager, the work you’ll do at GDIT will directly support the mission of the Department of Homeland Security. You will play a key role in transitioning the enterprise from its existing SAP environment to a modern SAP S/4HANA platform. In this role, you’ll oversee the planning, execution, and successful delivery of transition activities across a complex, mission‑essential SAP landscape.

You will ensure the project stays on schedule, within scope, and aligned with the customer’s technical and operational requirements. By guiding the migration strategy, coordinating teams, and managing risks, you will help the customer maintain efficient, accurate, and compliant financial operations throughout the transition. Your leadership enables the agency to modernize its system, improve automation, enhance data accuracy, and operate with greater transparency, reliability, and operational effectiveness to strengthen its mission.

Duties of the GDIT SAP Project Manager:

Signing Bonus included

The Director of Operations is responsible for the operational and administrative oversight of The Orthopedic Partners, a Rosenberg, Cooley, & Metcalf (RCM) Clinic, with locations in Park City, Cottonwood Heights & Heber. Primarily based on-site at the Park City Clinic location, this position coordinates office administration and clinical operations in order to ensure organizational effectiveness, efficiency and safety across all locations. Frequent travel between Park City, Cottonwood Heights & Heber locations will be required and includes oversight of an urgent care facility, physical therapy and pain management services, as well as supporting 12-15 physicians. This position will work closely with corporate centralized support services, including Marketing, RCM, Finance & Human Resources. The practice supports a team of approximately 120 employees and partners closely with the Market President across strategic planning, financial performance, staffing, and day-to-day clinic operations, while working closely with physicians to achieve exceptional clinical and operational results.

  • Clinical & Surgical Scheduling
  • Patient Experience & Customer Service
  • Financial Management & Budgeting (including RCM & EBITDA performance)
  • Recruiting; Retention & employee experience
  • Compliance, Privacy & Confidentiality (HIPAA)
  • Inventory & Supply Chain Management
  • EMR & Reporting Systems
  • Ambulatory Surgery Center Coordination
  • Company Culture & Communication Across Locations

  • Manage daily operations at multiple clinic locations and coordinate general work activities as well as clinical and surgical schedules.
  • Closely partner with key stakeholders to ensure organization needs are met with local ambulatory surgery centers.
  • Accurately and efficiently use EMR, including running and analyzing reports.
  • Ensure that staff deliver safe, high-quality patient care.
  • Build and maintain collegial, results-driven partnerships with physicians, aligning operational priorities with clinical goals to support practice growth and quality outcomes.
  • Partner with the Market President and physicians to develop growth initiatives, and meet or exceed operational EBITDA goals, for clinic operations and ensuring that these align with goals of the larger organization.
  • Partner with the Market President in the development of Clinic budgets and ensure that Clinic operations are maintained strictly within budgetary parameters.
  • Maintain office services and efficiency by planning and implementing effective office systems and measuring against established targets and standards
  • Partner with the Market President and HR in recruiting, retention and employee experience management activities
  • Ensure office staff are fully trained and providing high quality and efficient healthcare administrative services.
  • Prepare and track core stakeholder metrics through reporting, analysis; and presenting information to the Market President that identifies trends and potential areas of opportunity and growth
  • Ensure excellent quality, timeliness, and customer service throughout the entire patient experience

  • Ensure consistency and continuity of services by on-boarding and training new clinical employees and support staff
  • Management of general Clinic and Office supplies, including inventory and ordering
  • Facilitate activities and communication that promotes and reinforces company culture across clinic locations
  • Establishes and maintains effective, collegial relationships with patients, families, key stakeholders, facility and department staff, and collaborating physicians to support shared operational and clinical results.
  • Maintains effective relationships with partners (including local health care stakeholders) in the community and beyond.

title: Business Intelligence Developer
description:
Job Description

Role Summary

The BI Developer builds and operates the enterprise dashboards, semantic models, and reporting assets that make Masco's POS and adjacent commercial data usable to the business. This role delivers to the standards and direction set by the BI Delivery Leader and consumes the governed data foundation built by the Data Engineering team. The BI Developer contributes across the full BI lifecycle, including requirements confirmation, semantic modeling, dashboard build, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.

What You'll Own

Dashboard & Report Development

  • Build and maintain enterprise dashboards and reports on Power BI using governed enterprise data.

  • Deliver end-to-end reporting solutions including requirements confirmation, data sourcing, cleansing, normalization, and reporting.

  • Develop, automate, and run user-friendly dashboards and reports.

  • Handle report operations, refresh, and defect resolution for the enterprise BI layer.

Semantic Modeling & Metric Development

  • Build and improve Microsoft Tabular semantic models and metric definitions to support reporting requirements.

  • Implement enrichment metric calculations and segment classifications feeding the central dashboards.

  • Assist with logical and physical data modeling to support business initiatives, in partnership with Data Engineers.

  • Apply consistency and quality checks to metrics and semantic models before release.

Data Quality, Testing & Support

  • Ensure data accuracy and integrity in dashboards and reports through disciplined testing and validation.

  • Monitor automated ETL and BI processes for success and failures.

  • Conduct root cause analysis to resolve dashboard, model, and data delivery issues.

  • Provide general technical support and troubleshooting to BI end users.

Collaboration & Enablement

  • Collaborate with end users to identify needs and opportunities for improved data management and delivery.

  • Partner with the Data Engineering team on shared pipelines, models, and metric definitions.

  • Partner with fellow BI Developers on modeling standards and metric definitions.

  • Provide training and support to end users on BI tools, dashboards, and reports.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Document dashboard purpose, metric definitions, data sources, and refresh dependencies as part of the definition of done.

  • Follow the documentation standards established by the BI Delivery Leader and Enterprise Data Architect.

  • Contribute dashboard and semantic model metadata to the enterprise catalog.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field; equivalent professional experience considered.

  • Proven experience as a BI Developer, BI Analyst, or similar role, with demonstrated delivery of enterprise BI solutions.

  • Experience delivering end-to-end reporting solutions from requirements through production support.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced hands-on expertise with Power BI, including Tabular models, DAX, and semantic modeling.

  • Strong understanding of the medallion architecture (bronze / silver / gold) and how BI consumes governed enterprise data.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric and how it fits alongside Power BI in a modern enterprise BI platform.

  • Advanced SQL / T-SQL (queries, stored procedures, functions, DDL, DML) for data wrangling and reporting on large volumes of data.

  • Working knowledge of ETL/ELT patterns (Azure Data Factory, Databricks, SSIS or equivalent).

  • Working knowledge of the Azure data stack as it supports the BI layer.

  • Strong proficiency with data modeling, including ERDs, workflow diagrams, and dimensional (Kimball) modeling.

  • Working knowledge of data constructs including data types, normalization, data quality analysis, and efficient BI modeling.

  • Understanding of data governance, security, and access as they apply to enterprise BI and certified data sources.

Skills & Competencies

  • Detail-oriented and thorough. Ambitious and self-motivated with strong attention to accuracy.

  • Highly self-motivated and self-directed. Operates with minimal oversight on complex, hands-on BI work.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communicator.

  • Willingness to explore and understand new and modern BI and analytics tools to add value to the enterprise POS and POS-related analytics space.

  • Collaborative with Data Engineers, fellow BI Developers, and end users.

  • Continuous learner who stays current on modern BI and analytics practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in retail, consumer goods, or manufacturing analytics environments where POS, sell-in, inventory, and third-party retail data are core.

  • Understanding of retail metrics (turns, GMROI, margin, category performance).

  • Experience with Python, PowerShell, or other scripting languages for data automation.

  • Familiarity with Databricks Unity Catalog, data lineage, and observability tools.

  • Familiarity with modern DataOps, BIOps, Agile, or Kanban delivery practices.

title: Principal Product Manager, SNPL
description:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we’ve tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it’s supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we’re not just here to move money— we’re here to move our global customers forward.

We’re looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that’s you and you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

About the Role


Remitly is expanding beyond cross-border remittances to build a full suite of financial products that help consumers get paid, save, spend, and borrow — all built on the trust and reliability millions of customers already place in Remitly. As Principal Product Manager for Send Now Pay Later (SNPL), you will own one of the most consequential pillars of this vision: giving Remitly customers access to responsible, accessible credit and borrowing solutions that meet them where they are.


This is a senior, high-ownership role. You will define the strategy and roadmap for Remitly's borrowing products — after a customer is onboarded through long-term retention and healthy repayment outcomes — while working with a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, analysts, and internal partners. You will balance product growth with responsible lending principles, building financial tools that genuinely improve customers' lives. Critically, you understand that a healthy borrowing portfolio is inseparable from overall product engagement — and you will drive usage across the full Remitly Card plan, knowing that customers who find broad value in the plan stay longer, borrow more responsibly, and represent lower risk. This position reports to the General Manager of the Borrow team.

You Will:

  • Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for Remitly's suite of borrowing solutions, spanning early feature activation post-onboarding, ongoing engagement, proactive and reactive retention, and repayment experience.
  • Own the full product lifecycle — from discovery, requirements, and design collaboration through development, testing, launch, and ongoing optimization — ensuring consistent quality and velocity at every stage.
  • Drive early feature activation for newly onboarded members — designing the experiences and triggers that convert onboarded customers into active users (sending, saving, spending and borrowing), ensuring they quickly realize the value of Remitly Card features.
  • Drive engagement across the full Remitly Card plan — identifying opportunities to deepen usage of card features beyond borrowing, partnering with adjacent product teams to connect customers to relevant value, and using cross-feature engagement as a lever for retention and portfolio health.
  • Build proactive and reactive retention strategies — designing the triggers, interventions, and experiences that keep members engaged and in good standing, and that recover at-risk members before they lapse or default.
  • Develop a clear point of view on repayment UX and outcomes, treating repayment not as a back-office function but as a core product surface that builds trust, drives repeat borrowing, and protects the health of the portfolio.
  • Champion an AI-first way of working across the product lifecycle — using AI to accelerate research synthesis, experiment design, and spec writing, while identifying where AI can create differentiated product experiences within borrowing (e.g., dynamic credit offers, personalized repayment nudges, intelligent risk signals).
  • Define success metrics and instrumentation from day one — draw rates, repayment rates, retention cohorts, and cross-feature engagement — and build the experimentation and analytics framework to make fast, confident decisions.
  • Develop a strong competitive point of view on how borrowing products are evolving for immigrant and underserved consumer segments, and translate that into product bets that differentiate Remitly.
  • Represent the voice of the customer — conducting direct user research, synthesizing qualitative and quantitative signals, and building a roadmap that the full cross-functional team can rally around.
  • Communicate roadmap, trade-offs, and portfolio health clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and executive leadership, building alignment and momentum across Remitly's broader financial services strategy.

You Have:

  • 8+ years of product management experience, with significant time in consumer fintech or financial services products — including demonstrated ownership of a full customer lifecycle.
  • A track record of scaling a financial product from early-stage through high-volume usage, with measurable impact on retention and repayment or portfolio health outcomes.
  • Deep familiarity with lending and credit product dynamics — underwriting, draw behavior, repayment mechanics, delinquency management — and a strong instinct for where product decisions drive portfolio outcomes.
  • Experience driving cross-product or platform engagement, with an understanding of how feature breadth and usage depth connect to retention and customer lifetime value.
  • An AI-first mindset — you actively use AI tools in your daily workflow to move faster and better, and you're excited to explore where AI can power smarter, more personalized borrowing experiences.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills — comfortable defining metrics, reading SQL and data directly, building business cases, and using experimentation rather than intuition to drive decisions.
  • Experience working alongside Risk, Compliance, and Legal on regulated financial products, with the ability to navigate complex constraints without losing product velocity.
  • Sharp product sense and design instincts — you care about the nuances of a credit or repayment flow and can articulate why a customer experience builds or erodes trust.
  • Proven leadership in cross-functional environments — you know how to align engineers, designers, analysts, risk partners, and executives around a shared strategy and execute with clarity.
  • Comfort operating at senior levels of ambiguity; you make confident decisions with incomplete information and create momentum even when the path isn't fully defined.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is typically $176,000-$220,000. In the U.S., Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Our Benefits:

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Health, dental, and vision + 401k plan with company matching

  • Paid parental, medical, military and family care leave

  • Mental Health & Family Forming Benefits

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

  • Continuing education benefits

Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together


At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster.

Under the Company's current hybrid-work expectations, employees in this position work onsite Tuesday through Thursday each week. Additional onsite attendance may be required based on business needs, and the Company may modify its hybrid-work expectations from time to time. These intentional in-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most.

Remitly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: IT Supporter trainee
description:
Er du sulten efter at lære, ydmyg nok til at lære af andre og smart i måden, du samarbejder på?

Hos Monjasa søger vi en IT Supporter Trainee, der interesserer sig for teknologi og motiveres af at hjælpe mennesker, løse problemer og udvikle sig sammen med et stærkt team.

Et team, der løfter i flok

Du bliver en del af vores globale IT-organisation med base i Fredericia, hvor engagerede kolleger deler viden, sparrer og investerer i din udvikling. For os handler IT både om teknologi og mennesker – om at skabe gode oplevelser gennem nærværende service og få hverdagen til at fungere for kolleger på tværs af organisationen.

“Monjasa means personal business” er måden, vi møder hinanden på. Vores værdier – respekt, ambition, nysgerrighed samt smil & glæde – præger en kultur med stærke relationer, højt til loftet og fælles succes.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Fra første dag bliver du en vigtig del af teamet, hvor du udvikler dine tekniske kompetencer og får praktisk erfaring med support, service og samarbejde. Du hjælper kolleger med IT-udfordringer både onsite og remote og bidrager med idéer til smartere processer og løsninger. Samtidig får du masser af hands-on erfaring med at klargøre og installere computere, mobiltelefoner og andet IT-udstyr, vedligeholde brugere, adgange og systemer samt fejlsøge på hardware, software og netværk.

Hvem er du?

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra start – det vigtigste er din indstilling. Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har stor interesse for IT, teknologi og digitale løsninger
  • Er positiv, serviceminded og trives med kontakt til mange mennesker
  • Tager ansvar, arbejder struktureret og følger opgaver til dørs

Vi håber, at du kan spejle dig i vores fire værdier: respekt, ambition, nysgerrighed samt smil & glæde. De kommer til udtryk i måden, du møder andre på, tager initiativ, har lyst til at lære og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet.

Hvad får du til gengæld?

Du får et elevforløb i en international virksomhed med korte beslutningsveje og gode udviklingsmuligheder. Du bliver en del af et team, der fejrer succeser, hjælper hinanden gennem udfordringer og tror på, at arbejdsglæde og faglighed går hånd i hånd. Kommer du med engagement og lyst til at lære, giver vi dig et stærkt fundament for din fremtidige karriere.

Klar til at blive en del af holdet?

Vi ser frem til at byde vores næste IT Supporter trainee velkommen i januar 2027. Send os dit CV og en motiveret ansøgning, hvor du fortæller om dig selv, din interesse for IT og hvorfor du ser dig selv hos Monjasa. Har du en sjov fun fact, må du også gerne dele den – vi glæder os til at lære dig at kende.

Questions?

Cecilie Holm

HR Specialist

Monjasa as a workplace

Monjasa offers you a fulfilling career in a global organisation, where you will be part of a dynamic and ambitious team. We enjoy great learning opportunities and are proud of our fantastic working environment.

We are driven by our values of Respect, Ambition, Curiosity and Smile & Joy and by our corporate purpose of making our business personal and challenging the status quo. Among our colleagues, you will find more than 50 different nationalities, and we pride ourselves on being a diverse workplace with people of different backgrounds and beliefs. We truly believe that an inclusive workplace leads to a healthy working environment, where we are all onboard and thriving as a team.

Monjasa at a glance

Monjasa is a global partner in the oil and shipping industries and among the world’s top 10 largest marine fuel suppliers. Our core business includes trading and supplying marine fuels and shipowning activities globally.

We are characterised by a strong entrepreneurial spirit and have experienced strong developments since our start in 2002. Today, the Monjasa Group employs more than 700 traders, seafarers and other maritime specialists.

description:

12

Onsite

Seattle University will be one of the most innovative and progressive Jesuit and Catholic universities in the world, educating with excellence at the undergraduate, graduate, and professional levels. We embrace an intersectional framework for defining diversity in its broadest sense, including differences in gender, gender identity, race, ethnicity, generational history, culture, socioeconomic class, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, political perspectives, geographic origin and physical ability. Seattle University strives to be a welcome, open and safe campus climate for all who learn, live and work at Seattle University.


Seattle University's Core Competencies


Effective Team Collaboration: Works harmoniously with others towards a common goal, leveraging individual strengths to achieve shared objectives.


Emotionally Intelligent Communication: Engages in a skillful exchange of information, thoughts, and feelings, verbally and non-verbally.


Ethics and Integrity: Demonstrates an unwavering commitment to honesty, professionalism, and alignment with our Jesuit mission in all actions and decisions.


Flexibility and Innovation: Embraces change, approaching problems with curiosity adaptability, and is committed to making a positive impact.


Mindful Inclusion: Fosters mindful inclusion by consciously creating a workplace that celebrates differences, embraces cultural humility, and empowers uniqueness.


Outcomes-Driven Orientation: Sets clear objectives, pursues excellence, and delivers measurable outcomes while upholding Jesuit Catholic values.


Job Description Summary

The Admissions Evaluator – International Credential Evaluations carefully evaluates international transcripts for GPA calculations, transferable credit and major prerequisites. The Evaluator serves as a Designated School Official (DSO) and issues I-20's for international students to be able to apply for visas. As the subject matter expert in international evaluations, the Evaluator also plays a key role in functions related to admissions operations for all undergraduate applicants as part of a team of Admissions Evaluators, which includes evaluating transcripts and calculating GPA’s for domestic students, and maintaining data and applicant/record cleanliness.

Position Description:

International (60%)

  • Serves as the subject matter expert for evaluating secondary and post-secondary international credentials for incoming students. This includes calculating GPAs according to grading scales from other countries, determining course equivalencies from post-secondary institutions outside the United States, and applying applicants’ previous coursework towards Seattle University’s degree requirements.
  • Regularly reviews other components of international applications, including auditing for fulfillment of the university’s English Proficiency requirement and confirming citizenship information.
  • Serves as a Designated School Official (DSO), which involves issuing initial I-20's for incoming international students. Works in close partnership with the International Student and Scholar Center and participates in regular DSO trainings. Communicates with students on missing materials needed for I-20 issuance.
  • Serves as a member of the undergraduate international admissions group which includes the Sr. Assistant Director for International Recruitment and the International Transfer Admissions Counselor. Participates in regular meetings with the group and supports international functions in close collaboration with the Sr. Assistant Director for International Recruitment.
  • Supports with monitoring emails in the general international inbox and responding to student questions as needed.

General Admissions Operations (35%)

  • Determines course equivalencies and applies applicants’ previous coursework towards Seattle University’s degree requirements and posts appropriate equivalencies of transferred credit hours awarded and current class standing in the University’s ERP and CRM systems, specifically Colleague, Workday, and Slate.
  • Serves as an academic policy resource for incoming freshmen and transfer students regarding University Core and major transfer requirements for all undergraduate degrees and is a key contact for Transfer Admissions Counselors and designated academic liaisons throughout the University on academic policy matters related to the onboarding of undergraduate students with transferrable credit.
  • Adds course equivalencies to the online TES database system and assists in the development of effective tools/resources for best practices in communicating transfer course equivalencies to prospective transfers.
  • Assists in maintaining data and applicant/record cleanliness in various ways working closely with other individuals within the Admissions Operations team and Research and Analytics. These tasks may consist of editing small parts of multiple records, general audits, the scanning and assigning of documents, exporting of data for mass corrections, etc.

Other (5%)

  • Participates in office-wide committees, projects, and other duties as assigned in Undergraduate Admissions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.

title: Senior Enterprise Project Manager
description:
Job Description:

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Enterprise Project Manager is responsible for planning, executing, and delivering a diverse portfolio of complex IT, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and corporate projects across Anticimex North America (AxNA). This role serves as a central coordination point for cross-functional initiatives, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget while maintaining alignment with AxNA's strategic objectives. Reporting to the CIO North America, the Senior Enterprise Project Manager partners closely with IT, Operations, Finance, HR, and executive leadership to drive structured project governance, manage stakeholder expectations, and support organizational change across both technology transformation and corporate growth initiatives including acquisitions and integrations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead end-to-end project management for a mixed portfolio of IT, M&A, and corporate initiatives, including scoping, planning, resource coordination, execution, and closeout.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies), and status reports for all active projects.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, facilitating clear and consistent communication across IT, business, and executive audiences.
  • Coordinate M&A integration activities, including technology due diligence support, integration planning, onboarding of acquired entities, and tracking of post-close milestones.
  • Partner with IT leadership to prioritize and sequence projects within the broader IT portfolio, ensuring resource availability and alignment with strategic investment decisions.
  • Facilitate project governance, including steering committee meetings, milestone reviews, and executive status reporting.
  • Identify, escalate, and manage project risks and issues proactively, driving resolution to minimize impact on scope, schedule, and budget.
  • Manage project budgets, track actuals against forecasts, and report variances to IT leadership and finance stakeholders.
  • Coordinate cross-functional working groups and hold internal and external teams accountable to project commitments and deliverables.
  • Support vendor and third-party partner management within project contexts, including tracking SOW deliverables, milestones, and contract compliance.
  • Drive organizational change management activities within projects, including communication planning, training coordination, and stakeholder readiness assessment.
  • Maintain a centralized project management office (PMO) framework, including templates, standards, and reporting mechanisms to ensure consistency across all projects.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of project delivery practices, identifying lessons learned and implementing process enhancements.
  • Support the CIO North America in preparing executive-level project updates, board presentations, and investment summaries as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or related field preferred.
  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience will be considered

Experience:

  • 5–8 years of progressive project management experience in enterprise environments, leading complex IT initiatives such as enterprise systems implementations, integrations, or cloud migrations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing corporate/M&A-related projects with multi-site or multi-region scope, including direct engagement with senior leadership (VP and C‑level stakeholders) preferred.
  • Proven expertise in full project lifecycle management across complex technology, integration, and corporate initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience with multi-site M&A project coordination, including integration planning, due diligence support, and post-close tracking preferred.
  • Experience working directly with senior leaders (VP and C-level) and driving change across multiple business units preferred
  • Management Experience: Proven success managing cross-functional teams, external vendors, and senior stakeholders without direct authority, and partnering with executive leadership to drive structured project governance, manage stakeholder expectations, and support organizational change.
  • Industry Experience (Preferred): Experience in pest control, field service, home services, or similar multi-location, operations-driven service businesses is highly desirable.
  • Certifications: PMP certification strongly preferred; candidates actively pursuing PMP certification or with equivalent demonstrated project management experience will be considered.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

  • Proficiency with project management tools and platforms (e.g., Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging for technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • High degree of organizational rigor, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple concurrent projects without loss of quality.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to build trust and influence outcomes across geographically distributed teams and time zones.
  • Solid understanding of enterprise IT systems (i.e., ERP, CRM), infrastructure, and software delivery concepts sufficient to coordinate technical project teams effectively.
  • Skilled at supporting organizational change management, including stakeholder engagement, communications planning, and adoption tracking.
  • Self-directed and able to work independently in a fully remote environment with a disciplined approach to virtual collaboration, documentation, and follow-through.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Madison, New Jersey.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Madison area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Madison requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

When you accept:

  • You get paid

What you earn

  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.

The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. title: Product Manager til Betalingskort, Privat og Private Banking
description:
Vil du sætte retningen og levere på strategien for Betalingskort i Jyske Bank og være med til at sikre at Jyske Bank fortsætter med at have en førende markedsposition indenfor kort, digitale services og selvbetjeningsløsninger?

Om jobbet

Som Product Manager for kort til Privat og Private Banking har du ansvaret for den kommercielle, strategiske og kundevendte udvikling af kortområdet. Du sætter retningen for produktporteføljen, udvikler produkt- og prisstrategien og sikrer, at indsatsen omsættes til løsninger, der skaber værdi for kunder, rådgivere og banken.
Du har det helhedsorienterede ansvar for kort og tilhørende services og bliver en nøgleperson i arbejdet med at udvikle kundeoplevelsen og styrke Jyske Banks position på kortområdet. Du har ansvar for at omsætte strategien til konkrete initiativer og prioriteringer, der understøtter både kundernes behov og bankens forretningsmål.
Rollen kræver tæt samarbejde med Product Owners, udviklingsteams, forretningsområderne i Privat og Wealth Management samt eksterne partnere. Din evne til at skabe samarbejde, retning og fremdrift på tværs af organisationen er afgørende for dine resultater.

Dine primære ansvarsområder bliver at:

  • Sætte en tydelig retning og udvikle en sammenhængende produkt- og prisstrategi for kortområdet
  • Identificere kundernes behov, adfærd og udfordringer og omsætte indsigter og data til klare produktprioriteringer
  • Understøtte salget og sikre tæt samspil med afdelingsnettet og digitale kanaler
  • Drive end-to-end kunderejsen på tværs af kanaler, processer og systemer
  • Prioritere udviklingstiltag baseret på kundeværdi, forretning og regulering
  • Sikre høj kvalitet i implementeringer og salgsaktiviteter, så forretningsområderne effektivt kan levere på mål og forretningsplaner
  • Sikre risikostyring og kundevendt compliance for alle produkter, materialer og processer
  • Skabe optimering, effektivisering og sammenhængskraft i værdikæden

Om dig

Du har erfaring med kortområdet og trives med at sætte retning, skabe følgeskab og drive forretningsudvikling i komplekse værdikæder. Du bringer faglig tyngde fra den finansielle sektor og formår at skabe samarbejde og fremdrift på tværs af forskellige interessenter. Du motiveres af at omsætte ambitioner til konkrete resultater og skabe tydelig værdi for både kunder, rådgivere og organisationen.
Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har flere års erfaring som Product Manager eller fra en tilsvarende rolle med ansvar for kort produkter og tilhørende services
  • Kender kortbetalingsområdet i detalje, herunder 4-hjørne modellen
  • Har erfaring og kendskab til kortudbydere, processering og interaktion med eksterne stakeholders
  • Har erfaring med udvikling, prissætning og kommercialisering af kortprodukter og tilhørende services
  • Kan omsætte kundebehov, forretningsmål og teknologiske muligheder til en tydelig produktretning og konkrete prioriteringer
  • Arbejder analytisk og datadrevet og bruger både kvalitative og kvantitative indsigter til at træffe beslutninger
  • Har kunde- og forretningsforståelse og kan balancere kundeværdi, forretningsmål, teknologi, risiko og organisatoriske hensyn
  • Har erfaring med at arbejde tæt sammen med Product Owners og tværfaglige udviklingsteams om at omsætte produktretning til konkrete resultater.

Om os

Du bliver en del af Daglig Bank i Privat og Wealth Management – et nyetableret og ambitiøst område, der sætter Product Management tydeligt på dagsordenen i Jyske Bank.
Vi er i gang med at opbygge et kompetent fagligt miljø med tydeligt ansvar for retning, prioritering og værdi og med høje ambitioner for, hvordan vi arbejder med produkter, kunderejser, data og effekt.
Hos os får du ikke blot mulighed for at tage ansvar for dit eget fagområde. Du bliver også en del af at forme et nyt område, sætte standarden for vores måde at arbejde på og skabe løsninger, der kan mærkes af både kunderne, rådgiverne og banken.

Praktisk

Stillingen har base i Silkeborg / København. Der må forventes rejseaktivitet et par gange om måneden.

Ansøgning

HR Rekrutteringspartner, Jens Trøst Poulsen, vil tage sig af din ansøgning i samarbejde med Afdelingsdirektør for Daglig Bank René Thejsen. Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning via linket nedenfor. Ansøgningsfristen er d. 16 september. Vi inviterer ind til samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når vi har fundet rette kandidat.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet, der er vigtige for dig at få svar på, inden du søger, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Afdelingsdirektør René Thejsen på 61168579.
Vi oplever mangfoldighed som en ressource i vores opgaveløsning og i vores fællesskab. Derfor opfordrer vi alle til at søge – vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, hvor du beskriver netop dine evner i forhold til jobbet.

  • Provide comprehensive administrative support to Partners, Directors, Managers, and wider teams, ensuring work is completed accurately and within agreed deadlines.
