title: Drill Operator
description:
About EnterSource


EnterSource is a leading provider of broadband and fiber optic installation services, dedicated to expanding high-speed internet access to communities across the nation. We take pride in our commitment to quality, safety, and innovation. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a skilled and motivated Directional Driller to join our construction and installation team.


Position Overview


The Directional Driller is responsible for operating horizontal directional drilling (HDD) equipment to install underground fiber optic and conduit systems safely and efficiently. This role requires hands-on experience with drilling operations, attention to detail, and a strong focus on safety and precision. The ideal candidate will have experience in telecommunications or utility construction and be willing to travel for projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate directional drilling equipment to install conduit and fiber optic cables underground according to project specifications.
  • Read and interpret utility maps, blueprints, and job plans to determine drill paths and locate existing utilities.
  • Conduct bore planning, pilot drilling, reaming, and product pullback operations safely and efficiently.
  • Collaborate with locators, crew members, and project managers to ensure accuracy and job completion.
  • Perform daily equipment inspections, maintenance, and basic repairs as needed.
  • Ensure all work is performed in compliance with safety standards, local regulations, and company procedures.
  • Maintain accurate records of job details, including bore logs and material usage.
  • Travel to various project sites; overnight stays may be required.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience operating directional drilling equipment (Vermeer, Ditch Witch, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of HDD methods, underground utilities, and locating systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and utility locates.
  • Basic mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.
  • Valid driver’s license and clean driving record required.
  • Must be willing to travel extensively and work outdoors in varying conditions.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CDL Class A (or willingness to obtain).
  • Experience in fiber optic, telecommunications, or utility construction.
  • Knowledge of drilling fluids, ground conditions, and bore path calculations.
  • Safety certifications (OSHA 10/30, First Aid, CPR) are a plus.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive pay and travel per diem
  • On-the-job training and certification opportunities
  • Health, dental, and vision benefits
  • Career growth and advancement potential
  • A safety-focused, team-driven work environment
  • Paid sick leave, time off and holidays
  • Company-paid travel expenses
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Referral Bonus Program
  • Physical work – get paid to do your workout!
  • Opportunity to gain valuable skills in a growing industry!!

Employment is contingent on the successful completion of a pre-employment screen, including a drug test and an acceptable driving record.

Equal Employment Opportunity: We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and celebrate our employees' differences, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or Veteran status. Different makes us better. Employment with EnterSource is at-will and either party can terminate the relationship at any time with or without cause and with or without notice. This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice. This is a safety sensitive position. EnterSource is a drug-free workplace.

2116-D NEW BERN AVE , RALEIGH, North Carolina, 27610

  • Free movies & food

To Ensure EVERY Guest and Teammate Has An AWESOME Experience And Is EXCITED To Come Back

  • Prepares and plates Alamo menu items in according to our recipes and specs

  • Trained and available to work different stations as assigned, including dish, prep, fry, salad, grill, pizza, etc.

title: Vice President (VP), Finance - Saint Alphonsus Medical Group
description:
Employment Type:

Full time

Shift:

Description:

The Vice President, Finance provides financial leadership to support Saint Alphonsus Health System (SAHS) and Saint Alphonsus Medical Group (SAMG). This leader will have an emphasis on driving increased financial stewardship and implementation of consistent and best practice business processes. Serves as primary linkage between SAHS finance team for aligned physician relationships. Develops, prepares, and manages physician practice budgets, strategic financial plans and capital requests, assists in financial analysis of physician acquisitions, monitors performance, and supports improvement to ensure strong financial stewardship at both SAMG and SAHS. Mentors network executives and network finance leadership to strengthen business competencies.

Location: The VP of Finance will be fully on-site at the Boise Executive office.

Requirements:

  • MBA or financial related master's degree OR CPA with a bachelor's degree in accounting or finance.

  • Minimum 5 years' of relevant administrative experience (health care preferred) at a Senior Management level

  • Experience with health care operations, reimbursement methodologies, managed care monitoring systems, health care outcomes measurement systems, utilization review methodology and managed care organization operations

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

1. Knows, understands, incorporates, and demonstrates the mission, vision, and values of Trinity Health in leadership behaviors, practices, and decisions.

2. Must possess strong analytical and business management skills. Proven ability to communicate effectively with physician stakeholders and skills to present complex financial data and information to a range of audiences that include clinical and administrative stakeholders

3. Must possess a working knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles, thorough knowledge of reimbursement principles and operations, demonstrated experience with revenue cycle activities in a physician practice environment, and health care regulations

4. Provides finance leadership support and guidance to the Physician Practice Leadership, and system leadership and is part of the senior finance leadership team. Must have a thorough, broad-based knowledge of health care finance, multi-specialty physician practice financial operations, business planning/development, and payer environment. Knowledge gained through five or more years as a finance leader of a physician group practice of >50 physicians, or a system-level executive with finance responsibility for a physician group >50 directly managing large physician group finance and revenue cycle engagements.

5. Strong written and verbal communication skills.

6. Ability to identify, leverage and rapidly rollout system initiatives, with ability to lead through technical, political and cultural barriers to change. Must possess leadership skills including the ability to influence others and achieve results with and without direct line accountability, and function in both a leadership and support role in a team and system environment.

7. Must possess strong analytical and business management skills. Proven ability to communicate effectively with physician stakeholders and skills to present complex financial data and information to a range of audiences that include clinical and administrative stakeholders

8. Must possess a working knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles, thorough knowledge of reimbursement principles and operations, demonstrated experience with revenue cycle activities in a physician practice environment, and health care regulations.

9. A personal presence which is characterized by a sense of honesty, integrity and caring with the ability to inspire and motivate others to promote the philosophy, mission, vision, goals and values of Trinity Health.

10. Provides senior finance leadership and direction of SAMG, oversees the development of short and long-range goals and objectives and ensures system growth and integration of strategic financial plans with operations.

11. Responsible and accountable for leadership and operational direction and excellence including achievement of the Priority Strategic Aims (PSAs) within Saint Alphonsus Health System.

12. Serves as primary linkage between SAMG and SAHS finance team for aligned physicians. Maintains close communications, direction, feedback and support.

13. Works closely with accounting department on monthly close and makes recommendations to SAHS CFO on proper balance sheet reserves and allowances for SAMG.

14. Facilitates identification and execution of performance goals in cost management, business processes, provider compensation and other areas.

15. Establishes annual and multi-year SAMG employed physician networks financial targets (i.e. profitability by practice, per established physician, productivity, revenue per RVU, etc.), in conjunction with SAMG leadership and SAHS leadership.

16. Monitors SAMG employed physician networks financial performance against targets, and supports intervention, contingency planning and improvement when identified. Works with CAO to develop and execute performance improvement plans.

17. Provides financial leadership support for physician acquisitions with particular focus on valuation of practices, evaluation of employment arrangements and ROI analysis. Supports development and review of major SAMG capital project plans, physician acquisitions and strategic financial plans with SAMG and SAHS leadership.

18. Supports identification, design and implementation of SAHS initiatives, including common information systems, shared service centers, standardized policies and processes, etc. Specific initiatives may include determination of compensation models, physician acquisitions valuation standards, revenue cycle strategies and processes and information technology strategies.

19. As a member of SAMG leadership team, proactively works to streamline processes, clarify accountabilities, improve organizational capability and enhance financial stewardship in order to support SAHS objectives. Understands and promotes continuous quality improvement tools and methodologies for process redesign, leading key teams from across Trinity Health.

20. Provides financial leadership support for merger, divestiture and acquisition initiatives as required.

21. Provides leadership on key finance initiatives and promotes actions to achieve improved financial performance and outcomes.

22. Presents to SAMG and SAHS governance, and Trinity Home Office finance leadership team, on an as needed basis.

23. Works closely with the Trinity Home Office Physician Network VP, Finance and VP, Operations in executing plans and initiatives on PN performance and accountability.

24. Responsibility for calculating and ensuring timely processing of monthly PSA payments.

25. Coordinating and participating as a member of the SAMG Leadership Council Finance Committee, financial leadership and support for Canyon County Leadership Committee and other councils as deemed appropriate.

26. Review of information sent to finance for journal entry preparation including related to unbudgeted transfers, primary care occupancy smoothing.

27. Level 5 approver of Lawson.

28. NHSC support to the recruitment department.

29. Finance review and approval authority for SAMG-related PCR's sent to CCOIC.

LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

As a Trinity Health Leader, the incumbent is expected to demonstrate leadership traits which support our Mission Statement and Core Values as identified below:

Mission Statement: We, Trinity Health, serve together in the spirit of the Gospel as a compassionate and transforming healing presence within our communities.

Core Values:

  • Reverence: We honor the sacredness and dignity of every person.

  • Commitment to Those who are Poor: We stand with and serve those who are poor, especially those most vulnerable.

  • Justice: We foster right relationships to promote the common good, including sustainability of Earth.

  • Stewardship: We honor our heritage and hold ourselves accountable for the human, financial and natural resources entrusted to our care.

  • Integrity: We are faithful to those we say we are.

  • Safety: We embrace a culture that prevents harm and nurtures a healing, safe environment for all.

Vision

As a mission-driven, innovative health organization, we will become a leader in improving the

health of our communities and each person we serve. We will be the most trusted partner for life.

Promise Statement

We Listen. We Partner. We Make it Easy.

Our Actions

▪ Listen to understand.

▪ Learn continuously.

▪ Keep it simple.

▪ Create solutions.

▪ Deliver outstanding service.

▪ Own and speak up for safety.

▪ Expect, embrace and initiate change.

▪ Demonstrate exceptional teamwork.

▪ Trust and assume goodness of intentions.

▪ Hold myself and others accountable for results.

▪ Communicate directly with respect and honesty.

  • Experience sustaining engineering data packages to include specifications, drawings, interface documents
  • Experience sustaining long term service life systems through application of logistics practices including component performance monitoring, spares/resource monitoring, analytic forecasting, DMSMS, and alternate source/component replacement solutions

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Falls Church, Virginia.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Falls Church area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Falls Church requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Deposit Operations Document Imaging Representative
description:

The Deposit Operations Document Imaging Representative supports the efficient and accurate administration of Deposit Operations document imaging activities. This position is responsible for scanning, indexing, reviewing, and maintaining loan and operational documentation; monitoring incoming branch and department batches for accuracy; completing document management workflows; and responding to internal inquiries and requests for information. Du forstår hva som er det viktigste i en butikk er, nemlig kundene våre og kundereisen.

Du holder deg oppdatert på mote og trender og er opptatt av å følge med i markedet. Du liker å jobbe i et høyt tempo, er ikke redd for og ta i et tak og har et konkurranseinstinkt det lukter svidd av.

Du er en teamplayer som er opptatt av og skape et godt arbeidsmiljø rundt deg og bidrar positivt til gruppa.

Du har et øye for detaljer, og liker å jobbe med det visuelle i butikk.

Stillingen innebærer vakter dag, kveld og helger. Vi har også behov for at du kan stille opp ved sykdom, varetelling og ferieavvikling.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Vi arbeider i et sterkt konkurransemessig miljø, hvor vår innsats og innstilling gir resultater direkte på bunnlinjen. Vi hyller prinsippet om frihet under ansvar, og vi elsker mennesker som tar initiativ og som gjør en forskjell. Vi tror på, at det er den måte vi best utvikler vår forretning og hverandre.

title: Freezer and Dairy Clerk
description:
A World-Class Team

BJ’s Wholesale Club is powered by more than 30,000 team members who make a real impact every day. Whether you're stocking shelves, solving problems or shaping strategy, your work helps families save on what matters most.

We’re a team built on purpose and opportunity. Join us and be part of something meaningful.

Why You’ll Love Working at BJ’s

At BJ’s Wholesale Club, our team members are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being and future – both on and off the job. When you grow, we grow.

Here’s just some of what you can look forward to:

  • Weekly Pay: Get paid every week so that you can manage your money on your terms.
  • Free BJ’s Memberships: Enjoy a complimentary The Club Card Membership, plus a free Supplemental Membership for someone in your household.*
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Take the time you need with vacation, personal, sick days, holidays, bereavement, and jury duty leave.*
  • Flexible and Affordable Health Benefits: Choose from three medical plans, and access optional dental, vision, Health Savings Account (HSA), and flexible spending account options to fit your lifestyle.*
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan: Build your financial future with a company match (available to team members 18 and older).*
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan: Accumulate funds through after-tax payroll deductions that can be used to purchase shares of BJ’s common stock at a 15% discount.*

*Eligibility requirements vary by position.

Job Summary

The Dairy & Freezer Clerk is responsible for maintaining the dairy and freezer sections by ensuring proper stocking, rotation, and product integrity. This role supports merchandising, inventory management, and compliance with food safety standards while delivering excellent service to Members. The Dairy & Freezer Clerk plays an essential role in keeping the department organized and efficient, contributing to the overall success of the perishables team.

Team Member Engagement

  • Live our values: Demonstrate inclusive behavior, make ethical choices, and approach your work with a positive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Create a safe and collaborative environment: Foster open communication and trust.
  • Celebrate team members: Acknowledge others’ contributions, support team success, and help create a positive, encouraging work environment

Member Experience

  • Guarantee service excellence: Ensure daily execution of Grand Opening Look Daily (GOLD) Member Standards are met and are consistently reinforcing key service behaviors: Greet, Anticipate, Appreciate (GAA); Fast, Friendly, Full, Fresh, Clean; and Listen, Apologize, Solve, Thank (LAST) across all areas of the club.
  • Create a positive experience: Engage with Members in a friendly and helpful manner to contribute to a premium shopping experience.
  • Respond to Member needs: Address Member questions or concerns promptly and escalate unresolved issues to a supervisor when necessary.

Consistently Run Great Clubs with Great Standards

  • Maintain Club Standards: Consistently Delivering GOLD Standards in your club.
  • Contribute to club goals: Perform daily responsibilities with accuracy and consistency to support improvement in key performance areas and help the club meet or exceed targets.

Achieve Financial Performance

  • Cost Discipline: Use supplies responsibly and follow scheduling expectations to help the club stay within labor and supply goals.
  • Support Performance and Profitability: Complete tasks efficiently and accurately and follow best practices to help drive strong club results.
  • Understand the Business: Learn how your role impacts key club metrics and contribute to overall department performance through consistent execution.

Major Tasks, Responsibilities, and Key Accountabilities

  • Ensure planogram integrity in dairy and freezer: Stock all dairy and freezer products according to company planograms to maintain visual standards and ensure consistent member experience.
  • Maintain cold chain and in-stock accuracy: Support cold chain integrity by monitoring temperature control and replenishing low or missing items to ensure freshness and availability.
  • Execute proper product rotation: Apply FIFO (First In, First Out) rotation procedures to reduce waste and maintain optimal product quality.
  • Conduct quality and date checks: Regularly inspect products for expiration dates and condition, removing any damaged or outdated items to uphold food safety standards.
  • Ensure food safety and sanitation compliance: Follow all food safety and sanitation standards, including the routine cleaning of coolers, freezers, equipment, and shelving.
  • Support product availability: Monitor dairy and freezer in-stock levels and assist with replenishment efforts to maintain a full and shoppable department.
  • Ensure accurate signage and pricing: Verify that all items are correctly signed and priced to avoid member confusion and support smooth checkout operations.
  • Support seasonal merchandising initiatives: Assist with seasonal transitions and merchandising plans to drive sales and enhance the member shopping experience.
  • Comply with all company policies and procedures: Execute all dairy and freezer operations in alignment with company standards to ensure consistency and operational excellence.
  • Perform other duties as assigned: Provide additional support across departments as needed.
  • Maintain regular, predictable, full attendance: Demonstrate consistent presence to support operations, provide leadership coverage, and ensure smooth club execution.

Qualifications

  • 1+ year of experience in dairy, freezer, grocery, or retail operations preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of cold chain management, food safety standards, and product handling requirements.
  • Strong attention to detail with organizational and multitasking skills.
  • Proficiency in basic computer applications (MS Word, Excel, Email) preferred.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

Job Conditions

  • Frequent standing and movement on hard surfaces.
  • Regular lifting of up to 30 pounds; occasional heavier lifting with assistance.
  • Exposure to temperature variations in refrigerated and freezer storage areas.
  • Potential exposure to cleaning agents and frozen/dairy-related allergens

In accordance with the Pay Transparency requirements, the following represents a good faith estimate of the compensation range for this position. At BJ’s Wholesale Club, we carefully consider a wide range of non-discriminatory factors when determining salary. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, education, experience, and qualifications. The pay range for this position is $17.00 - $20.83

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Franklin Lakes, New Jersey.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Franklin Lakes area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Franklin Lakes requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

You will play a key role in supporting the supply chain operations of our company by managing personnel and processes to ensure efficient distribution of goods. title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Gaithersburg, Maryland.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Gaithersburg area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Gaithersburg requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: UEFI BIOS Engineer
description:
Lattice Overview

There is energy here…energy you can feel crackling at any of our international locations. It’s an energy generated by enthusiasm for our work, for our teams, for our results, and for our customers. Lattice is a worldwide community of engineers, designers, and manufacturing operations specialists in partnership with world-class sales, marketing, and support teams, who are developing programmable logic solutions that are changing the industry. Our focus is on R&D, product innovation, and customer service, and to that focus, we bring total commitment and a keenly sharp competitive personality.

Energy feeds on energy. If you flourish in a fast paced, results-oriented environment, if you want to achieve individual success within a “team first” organization, and if you believe you can contribute and succeed in a demanding yet collegial atmosphere, then Lattice may well be just what you’re looking for.

Job Description:

Member Technical Staff I - UEFI BIOS DEVELOPMENT

ABOUT LATTICE SEMICONDUCTOR – AMI

Lattice Semiconductor is the low power FPGA leader with 8,000+ customers

globally. We're transforming how the world processes data by delivering

innovative semiconductor solutions that enable our customers to differentiate

their products and accelerate their growth.

Our India team plays a critical role in this mission, contributing to product

development, design, verification, and customer support across multiple

technical disciplines. We're building a culture of technical excellence,

innovation, and collaboration.

THE ROLE

A modern computing platform is only as good as the firmware that brings it to life.

At Lattice Semiconductor/AMI, we're looking for a member of technical staff I who thrives on solving complex platform initialization challenges and is passionate about building world-class UEFI BIOS solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise with hands-on development across multiple generations of Intel, AMD, and Arm platforms.

You will work closely with silicon vendors, platform architects, hardware teams, and customers to develop, debug, optimize, and deliver BIOS solutions that power some of the industry's most advanced computing platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Development, and integration of UEFI BIOS features across Intel, AMD, and Arm-based platforms

• Develop BIOS firmware using UEFI, PI specifications, EDK II, and Aptio V technologies

• Collaborate with silicon vendors, platform architects, hardware teams, and customers to define and implement platform requirements

• Enable new silicon and reference platforms from early bring-up through production release

• Debug complex system boot issues involving CPU initialization, memory, PCIe, power management, security, and platform firmware components

• Perform low-level firmware debugging using Intel ITP, JTAG, UART, logic analyzers, and other platform debug tools

• Analyze hardware schematics, board layouts, and platform architecture to diagnose system-level issues

• Implement and maintain industry-standard firmware interfaces, including PCIe, ACPI, SMBIOS, USB, TPM, Secure Boot, and related platform technologies

• Drive firmware quality, performance optimization, and platform reliability improvements

• Work closely with validation and customer engineering teams to resolve technical issues and ensure successful product releases

• Document firmware architecture, design decisions, debug methodologies, and customer solutions

• Stay current with emerging firmware technologies, chipset architectures, security requirements, and industry standards

WHAT YOU BRING

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline

• 3+ years of UEFI, BIOS development experience

• Strong understanding of Intel IA32 and x64 architecture

• Strong programming skills in C and Assembly language

• Extensive experience in BIOS, UEFI, PI, and EDK II development

• Deep understanding of PC architecture and platform initialization flows

• Experience enabling and debugging Intel, AMD, and/or AArch64-based platforms

• Strong knowledge of platform firmware standards including PCIe, ACPI, SMBIOS, USB, and related specifications

• Experience reading hardware schematics and board-level layouts

• Proven expertise in low-level system debugging and hardware troubleshooting

• Hands-on experience with platform debug tools

• Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Self-starter capable of driving solutions independently and delivering results in a fast-paced environment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field

• 3+ years of BIOS or firmware development experience

• Experience with Aptio V firmware architecture

• Experience enabling server, AI server, edge computing, embedded, or IoT platforms

• Knowledge of firmware security technologies including Secure Boot, TPM, TME, SEV, TXT, and related platform security solutions

• Familiarity with CRA, NIST, and emerging firmware security compliance requirements

• Experience working directly with OEMs, ODMs, silicon vendors, or hyperscale customers

LOCATION

Chennai , India

Additional Information:

This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in:

India

Lattice recognizes that employees are its greatest asset and the driving force behind success in a highly competitive, global industry. Lattice continually strives to provide a comprehensive compensation and benefits program to attract, retain, motivate, reward and celebrate the highest caliber employees in the industry.


Lattice is an international, service-driven developer of innovative low cost, low power programmable design solutions. Our global workforce, some 1,000 strong, shares a total commitment to customer success and an unbending will to win. For more information about how our FPGA, CPLD and programmable power management devices help our customers unlock their innovation, visit www.latticesemi.com. You can also follow us via Twitter, Facebook, or RSS. At Lattice, we value the diversity of individuals, ideas, perspectives, insights and values, and what they bring to the workplace. Applications are welcome from all qualified candidates.

title: Experienced Strategy Consultant
description:
Help shape how technology and AI create value for Danske Bank.

Technology and AI are increasingly shaping how Danske Bank delivers value to customers, supports colleagues and executes on its strategic ambitions. As our new experienced Strategy Consultant, you will help senior leaders navigate complex choices by providing perspectives, analyses and recommendations that support both current priorities and future strategic ambitions.

You will join the T&S Strategy team, where we work closely with the T&S Leadership Team, Group Strategy and senior stakeholders across the bank. Together, we facilitate strategic planning, investment prioritisation and executive discussions, helping ensure that technology, AI and broader business considerations are reflected in the bank's most important decisions.

From annual business reviews and strategic investment choices to group-wide strategy discussions, you will help bring clarity, challenge, and a holistic perspective to topics that matter for the future of Danske Bank.

What you will be doing

In this role, you will work on some of the most important strategic topics across Technology & Services and the wider bank.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting executive decision-making through analyses, recommendations and leadership materials.
  • Facilitating strategic planning and investment prioritisation processes, including annual business reviews.
  • Designing and leading workshops, strategy discussions and governance forums for senior stakeholders.
  • Representing Technology & Services in group-wide strategy processes and contributing technology perspectives to strategic discussions.
  • Bringing together insights and inspiration from across the bank, peers and the broader market to help inform decisions and challenge existing perspectives.

What we are looking for

We imagine that you:

  • Bring extensive experience from strategy consulting, corporate strategy or a similar advisory role (+5 years).
  • Excel at structuring complex problems and translating analysis into clear recommendations for decision-makers.
  • Can connect business and technology perspectives to form a holistic view and guide strategic discussions.
  • Are a confident facilitator and trusted partner to senior stakeholders.
  • Build strong relationships across organisational boundaries and collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
  • Are curious about how technology, including AI, can enable business ambition and long-term value creation.

Why join us

  • Work on strategic priorities at the heart of Danske Bank's technology and transformation agenda.
  • Collaborate closely with senior leaders across Technology & Services and the wider bank.
  • Influence decisions with impact across one of the largest technology organisations in the Nordics.
  • Help shape how technology and AI support the delivery of the bank's strategic ambitions.
  • Build a broad network and develop as part of a high-performing strategy team.

We believe that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and encourage qualified candidates to apply regardless of background, identity or experience.

Interested?

If you are excited by the opportunity to help senior leaders make informed strategic decisions and contribute to the continued development of Technology & Services, we would love to hear from you.

For any questions, you are welcome to contact the hiring manager, Troels Bøgh Pedersen on trped@danskebank.dk

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Lancaster, Pennsylvania.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Lancaster area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Lancaster requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Data protection & GDPR
description:
Who are we?


Quanteam, founding entity of RAINBOW PARTNERS, is a consulting firm specialized in Banking and Financial Services. With more than 1200 consultants across 10 countries, we combine business and IT expertise to support leading institutions in transformation projects.


Our core areas:

➡ Quantitative Finance

➡ Risk & Compliance

➡ Operations & Finance

➡ Transformation & Organization

➡ Information Systems.


We are looking for a Privacy Counsel (GDPR & Data Protection)


MAIN TASKS


  • Provide day-to-day legal advice on GDPR and local data protection laws across several European jurisdictions.
  • Monitor regulatory developments (GDPR, ePrivacy, EU AI Act and related frameworks) and translate them into practical business guidance.
  • Draft legal opinions, privacy policies, procedures and privacy notices.
  • Maintain Records of Processing Activities (RoPA) and support the continuous improvement of the privacy governance framework.
  • Conduct and review Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and legitimate interest assessments.
  • Embed Privacy by Design and by Default into new products, services and business initiatives.
  • Review AI and data-driven projects from a privacy compliance perspective.
  • Draft, review and negotiate Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) and data-sharing agreements.
  • Advise on international data transfers, including Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and Transfer Impact Assessments.
  • Manage Data Subject Rights requests and support personal data breach assessments and notifications.
  • Collaborate closely with Legal, Information Security, IT, HR, Procurement and other business stakeholders across Europe.
  • Deliver privacy awareness initiatives and prepare compliance reporting for senior stakeholders.


🧩 YOUR PROFILE AND SKILLS

  • Law degree with qualification in an EU jurisdiction (preferred).
  • 4–7 years of experience in Data Protection and Privacy.
  • Strong practical knowledge of GDPR and at least one European jurisdiction's privacy legislation.
  • Experience drafting and negotiating DPAs, data-sharing agreements and international transfer documentation.
  • Experience conducting DPIAs, RoPAs and privacy risk assessments.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to translate complex legal requirements into practical business advice.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Proactive attitude and ability to work independently.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • Knowledge of French is a plus.
  • Hybrid position based in Lisbon.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Permanent contract (CTI).
  • Meal allowance.
  • Health Insurance.
  • Extra holiday: Christmas Eve or New Year’s Eve.
  • Access to Quanteam Academy for continuous learning and certifications.
  • Elevate Program to support professional development and career growth.
  • Career progression plan.
  • Ongoing follow-up and technical support provided by a Consultant Expert.

title: Senior Director, Software Engineering -  SSE/SASE & Zero Trust
description:
SonicWall is a cybersecurity forerunner with more than 30 years of expertise and is recognized as a leading partner-first company, ensuring our partners and their customers are never alone in the fight against cybercrime. With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose-built security solutions to enable any organization—enterprise, government agencies and SMBs—around the world. For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a Senior Director of Software Engineering to lead the architecture, development, and global scale-out of our Security Service Edge (SSE) platform.
This role is responsible for building and evolving our cloud-native security platform that delivers comprehensive protection across users, devices, applications, data, and network traffic — spanning branch, hybrid, multi-cloud, and internet environments.
The ideal candidate is a seasoned engineering leader with deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, and enterprise security platforms. You will shape the long-term technical strategy, drive execution excellence, and build a high-performing engineering organization in India that supports a globally deployed SaaS platform.

Key Responsibilities:
• Define and execute the long-term engineering roadmap for the SSE platform aligned with business objectives.
• Build, mentor, and scale high-performing engineering teams.
• Establish strong architectural governance, engineering best practices, and quality standards.
• Champion secure-by-design principles across application code, infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Partner closely with Product Management to evolve core SSE capabilities including Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Secure Web Gateway (SWG), CASB, policy engines, traffic inspection, analytics, and identity integrations.
• Recruit and retain top engineering talent in cloud, distributed systems, and cybersecurity domains.
• Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, operational rigor, and continuous improvement.

Required Skills & Experience:
• 15+ years in software development and 5+ years in engineering leadership
• Proven experience building and scaling SaaS engineering teams.
• Strong track record of delivering complex, cloud-native security or networking products.
• Deep understanding of SSE/SASE architecture principles and zero-trust frameworks.
• Strong background in distributed systems, microservices architectures, and hyperscale environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
• Experience with identity systems (SSO, MFA, OAuth, SAML), policy engines, and traffic inspection frameworks.
• Familiarity with DevOps best practices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, reliability engineering, and automation.
• Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Go and Python.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Riverview, Florida.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Riverview area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Riverview requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

title: Artistic Administrator
description:
Department: Artistic Planning

Reports to: Chief of Artistic Planning

Supervises: Artist Liaison/Asst. to the Music Director

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary: $85,000-95,000 annual


The Seattle Symphony unleashes the power of music, brings people together and lifts the human spirit. Recognized as one of the “most vital American orchestras” (NPR), the Seattle Symphony is internationally acclaimed for its inventive programming, community-minded initiatives, and superb recordings on the Seattle Symphony Media label. With a strong commitment to new music and a legacy of over 150 recordings, the orchestra has garnered five Grammy Awards, 26 Grammy nominations, two Emmy Awards and was named Gramophone’s 2018 Orchestra of the Year. The Symphony performs in Benaroya Hall in the heart of downtown Seattle, reaching over 500,000 people annually through live performances and radio broadcasts.


Position Overview:

The Artistic Administrator supports the Chief of Artistic Planning to implement the artistic strategy of the Seattle Symphony, ensuring the smooth operation of the Artistic Planning department including in particular pertaining to visiting artists, orchestras, and ensembles.

This position requires attention to detail, flexibility, and commitment to the Seattle Symphony values of Excellence, Innovation, Curiosity, Collaboration, Respect, Inclusivity, Integrity, and Service. This position supports the Seattle Symphony’s principles of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion.

This position is hybrid remote and in-person with Mondays and Fridays remote and Tuesdays-Thursdays at Benaroya Hall. Regular evening and weekend work is required and scheduled on a monthly basis.


Key Responsibilities and Duties:

Reporting to the Chief of Artistic Planning, the below summarizes the position’s key responsibilities:


1. Artistic Planning and Strategy:

· Manage administration for classical music programming including guest artist contracts, riders, payments, tax forms, international visas, and conductor forms.

· Contributing to shape and implement the artistic strategy of the Seattle Symphony.

· Programming repertoire and negotiating fees for specific projects.

· Providing oversight and managing the Artistic Department budget with entry and tracking of all budget items; leading discussions in budget meetings; tracking expenditure and reporting variances.

· Identifying artists, conductors, composers, program concepts, researching new repertoire, commissioning and partnership opportunities, artist availabilities, and other ideas to keep the Seattle Symphony artistically fresh, innovative, and aligned with its long-term artistic vision.

· Collaborate with Education and Community Engagement to fully integrate opportunities for access and amplification of programs.

· Collaborate with Marketing and Communications to review and edit program notes as well as the monthly program magazine Encore with an eye for program and guest artist content.

· Performing concert duty including concert/event oversight.

· Providing administrative support for Chief of Artistic Planning as needed.


2. Supervision of Staff

· Manage one direct report, Artist Liaison / Assistant to the Music Director.


3. Recording and Media

· Devising plans, managing the schedule, and obtaining artist approvals for monthly radio broadcasts on Classical KING 98.1 radio.

· Contributing to the selection of potential projects for Seattle Symphony Media releases.

· Negotiating artist approvals for Seattle Symphony Media, other recording projects, and additional usage of recordings where required.


4. Octave 9 New Music Series

· In consultation with Chief of Artistic Planning, programming and hosting the new music series in Octave 9: Raisbeck Music Center. Continuing to build the profile and activity of Octave 9 within the Seattle artistic community and further afield.

· Building relationships with similar artistic organizations and explore collaboration between them on creative projects.

· Contributing to the artistic planning process and introduce new programming ideas, with thorough knowledge of classical artists, repertoire, and industry trends.


5. Relationships

· Developing and maintaining relationships with guest conductors, soloists, composers and other artists, as well as managers and/or business agents for artists.

· Building relationships with other orchestra administrators and presenters.

· Participating in production and operations meetings and collaborating with artists and production staff.


6. Other duties as required

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Virginia Beach, Virginia.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Virginia Beach area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Virginia Beach requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Trader
description:
Monjasa is looking for a Trader
Ready to make your mark in a global trading environment where people and relationships truly come first?

At Monjasa, we’re looking for a passionate and proactive trader to join our dynamic team. You will be part of a fast-paced trading floor, working closely with customers and suppliers worldwide.

Here is how Anis Cengic, Trading Manager for Northwest Europe, describes the opportunity:

“As a Trader at Monjasa, you become part of a fast-paced, collaborative trading floor where strong relationships and teamwork drive exceptional results. Our Personal Business approach means you will work closely with customers and suppliers around the world, ensuring vessels are fuelled across global waters. It is dynamic, it is engaging and you will be working alongside some of the most skilled professionals in the industry.”

What makes Monjasa extraordinary?

Monjasa is not just another trading company. It is a place where people, purpose, and ambition come together:

People-first culture: Genuine relationships drive our success.
Global impact: Your decisions will literally keep ships moving around the world.
A playground for growth: New ideas are welcomed, and ambition is celebrated.
A workplace you enjoy coming to: With unique facilities, vibrant offices, and a strong sense of community, we make sure joy is part of the job.
Values in action: Respect, curiosity, ambition, and smile & joy are not just words on a wall. They shape how we act, collaborate, and succeed together.

What you will do in your new role:

  • Day-to-day trading
  • Smart logistics planning
  • Build strong global relationships
  • Spot new business opportunities

You bring:

  • Experience in bunker trading/shipping or sales
  • A natural sales mindset
  • Strong communication & negotiation skills
  • Fluent in English
  • A proactive, ambitious, team‑driven personality

If you are sharp, energetic, and thrive in a collaborative trading environment, this is your moment and we will look forward to hearing from you!

Questions?

Cecilie Holm

HR Specialist

Contact Cecilie

E-mail: hr.eur@monjasa.com

Phone: +45 76 317 392

We look forward to receiving your application no later than 30 September 2026. In the meantime, we encourage you to take a look into Monjasa and read more about the company here.

In case you encounter any problems when uploading your application?
Please contact HR support on this email: hr.eur@monjasa.com

Monjasa as a workplace

Monjasa offers you a fulfilling career in a global organisation, where you will be part of a dynamic and ambitious team. We enjoy great learning opportunities and are proud of our fantastic working environment.

We are driven by our values of Respect, Ambition, Curiosity and Smile & Joy and by our corporate purpose of making our business personal and challenging the status quo. Among our colleagues, you will find more than 50 different nationalities, and we pride ourselves on being a diverse workplace with people of different backgrounds and beliefs. We truly believe that an inclusive workplace leads to a healthy working environment, where we are all onboard and thriving as a team.

Monjasa at a glance

Monjasa is a global partner in the oil and shipping industries and among the world’s top 10 largest marine fuel suppliers. Our core business includes trading and supplying marine fuels and shipowning activities globally.

We are characterised by a strong entrepreneurial spirit and have experienced strong developments since our start in 2002. Today, the Monjasa Group employs more than 700 traders, seafarers and other maritime specialists.

With a fleet of some 30 vessels and 15 office locations in Europe, the Americas, the Middle East & Africa and Asia, we are a close shipping partner in more than 800 ports worldwide.

Monjasa Group revenue reached a total of USD 4bn in 2025.

description:

Seattle University will be one of the most innovative and progressive Jesuit and Catholic universities in the world, educating with excellence at the undergraduate, graduate, and professional levels.
