Job Description Summary

The Executive Coordinator provides high-level administrative and operational support to the Dean of the College of Science and Engineering, contributing to the effective leadership and advancement of the College. This position supports the Dean’s efforts to promote and represent the College within the University and with external constituents, including donors, alumni, corporate partners, prospective students, and other key stakeholders.

The Executive Coordinator manages administrative functions within the Dean’s Office and supports special projects and initiatives as directed by the Dean. The position also serves as a key resource to faculty and staff, providing guidance and information related to University and College policies, procedures, rank and tenure processes, and business operations.

The Executive Coordinator reports directly to the Dean of the College of Science and Engineering and plays an important role in fostering effective communication, coordination, and collaboration across the College.

Position Description:

This position supports the efforts of the dean to lead and promote the college both within the university and externally to donors, alumni, corporate partners, and prospective students, etc. The executive coordinator is responsible for administrative support duties in the Dean's Office and supports various projects as the dean requires. This position serves as a resource for faculty and staff regarding policies, procedures, rank and tenure, and the business functions of the college. This position reports to the Dean of the College of Science and Engineering.

Essential Job Functions

Executive Assistant (45%)

  • Schedule the dean's meetings with faculty, staff, other members of the university community, donors, and visitors.

  • Take minutes and transcribe same for Executive Committee meetings as well as college-wide meetings, as needed.

  • Make travel arrangements for the dean. Communicate with the appropriate offices on campus to fulfill the dean's requests for information.

  • Collaborate with college’s development officer to set up donor meetings for the dean, special visits, and events.

  • Serve as contact for requests for college calendar postings. Oversee permissions for college listservs.

  • Provide administrative support for the Executive Committee, Student Advisory Council, faculty searches, rank & tenure process, annual performance reviews, sabbaticals, and other activities designated by the dean.

Event Planner (20%)

  • Arrange faculty/staff meetings, events and all college-wide receptions and gatherings.

  • Create agendas, schedules, orders of events and briefs for events as needed.

  • Collaborate with other college and university principals as needed for event planning.

  • Create and maintain invitations, name tags and RSVP lists.

  • Coordinate with CES, Catering and ITCS as needed.

Clerical (15%)

  • Keep track of forms requiring dean's signature and route them accordingly.

  • Maintain/update personnel files of faculty members and college roster updates.

  • Coordinate rank-and-tenure dossier submission and support rank-and-tenure process within the college.

  • Produce grade distribution reports for faculty members seeking promotion and/or tenure.

  • Handle paperwork for annual performance reviews, sabbatical requests, and junior faculty development leaves.

Reporting (10%)

  • Using university systems, collect data and produce various reports, including, but not limited to: enrollment trends, student credit hours generated, and other measures of the productivity of individual departments and the entire college.

  • Prepare presentations for dean.

Office Reception (10%)

  • Receive and direct incoming phone calls, greet visitors, and provide visitors and callers with general information.

  • Route mail and packages.

Compensation at a Glance

$52,000 - $62,000


Application Instructions


Please attach a cover letter with your resume when applying. Job postings are open until filled, unless otherwise specified.


Seattle University has provided a compensation range that represents its good faith estimate of what the University may pay for the position at the time of posting. The salary offered to the selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as the qualifications of the selected candidate, departmental budget availability, internal salary equity considerations, and available market information, and not based on a candidate’s gender or any other protected status.


Your total compensation goes beyond the number on your paycheck. Seattle University provides generous leave, health plans, and retirement contributions that add to your total compensation package.

Benefits at a Glance

Consistent with its fundamental Jesuit values, Seattle University offers a wide range of benefits designed to care for the whole person. Choose from three different medical plans, a dental, and vision insurance programs. Protect your income with life, short & long-term disability coverage. Plan for your future with up to a 10% employer contribution for retirement benefits, comprised of a 5% nonelective employer contribution and an additional dollar-for-dollar match of your voluntary contributions up to a maximum of 5%. You may also take advantage of 100% paid tuition benefits for the employee and dependents, a subsidized transportation benefit, a wellness program with free access to an onsite fitness facility, and a wide variety of campus events. Enjoy a generous holiday schedule, including a paid Holiday break closure in December, vacation and paid sick leave, and paid community service leave. For more information explore the Benefits website at: https://www.seattleu.edu/hr/benefits/

Positions designated as hybrid eligible may offer the opportunity for a hybrid work schedule after successful completion of an introductory period of 3–6 months. In these cases, the role typically begins fully on campus to support onboarding and training, with the potential to transition to a hybrid arrangement thereafter.

Positions designated as on-site are not eligible for hybrid work and are expected to remain fully on campus.

All flexible work arrangements are subject to periodic review and may be modified or discontinued at any time at the university’s discretion.

title: Ekstrahjelp ONLY Buskerud
description:
Vi ser etter en SUPERSELGER med et glimt i øyet som kan bli en del av Team Buskerud, Krokstadelva!

Vil du bli med på reisen?

ONLY Stores er i sterk utvikling, og vi søker derfor en superselger til Team Buskerud.

Bli en del av ONLY Stores

ONLY Stores har vært på en forrykende reise gjennom de siste fem år, og vi er langt fra ferdige med reisen. Vår forretningsplan har vist seg å være riktig. Vi har hatt vårt primærfokus på to ting – våre produkter og våre medarbeidere. Som en del av organisasjonen i ONLY Stores kan du i høy grad få det ansvaret du ønsker, de oppgaver du brenner for, og ikke minst være en del av et fantastisk team.

Hos ONLY Stores vet vi at våre medarbeidere gjør en stor forskjell!

Jobben

Som selger hos oss så forventer vi at du er over 18 år, og at du er glad i et høyt tempo hvor ingen dag er lik.

Du forstår hva som er det viktigste i en butikk er, nemlig kundene våre og kundereisen.

Du holder deg oppdatert på mote og trender og er opptatt av å følge med i markedet. Du liker å jobbe i et høyt tempo, er ikke redd for og ta i et tak og har et konkurranseinstinkt det lukter svidd av.

Du er en teamplayer som er opptatt av og skape et godt arbeidsmiljø rundt deg og bidrar positivt til gruppa.

Du har et øye for detaljer, og liker å jobbe med det visuelle i butikk.

Stillingen innebærer vakter dag, kveld og helger. Vi har også behov for at du kan stille opp ved sykdom, varetelling og ferieavvikling.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

ONLY Stores er en del av BESTSELLER Retail Europe vi har eksisteret i mer enn 25 år og driver konseptbutikker under følgende brands: ONLY, ONLY & SONS & JDY.

Vi har base i Brande, hvor vi er 40 dedikerte kollegaer, som beskjeftiger oss med drift av butikker. Vi driver BESTSELLER Retail Europe ut fra ledelsesmessige verdier, som bygger på fremgang for enhver pris, nærhet til våre kollegaer og butikker og en uskuelig tro på, at vi kan gjøre det enda bedre i morgen.

Vi arbeider i et sterkt konkurransemessig miljø, hvor vår innsats og innstilling gir resultater direkte på bunnlinjen. Vi hyller prinsippet om frihet under ansvar, og vi elsker mennesker som tar initiativ og som gjør en forskjell. Vi tror på, at det er den måte vi best utvikler vår forretning og hverandre.

The skills you bring

description:

title: Day Service Facilitator
description:
Who We Are

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith- and values-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life - there is a place for everyone to belong here.

Mission Statement

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.

Job Description:

POSITION PURPOSE SUMMARY:

The Day Service Facilitator works together with the staff team to develop and implement appropriate recreational, social, and educational programming which incorporates the needs, interests and preferences of the members through individual or group activities. The incumbent will be required to provide emotional and physical support along with crisis intervention as needed. Note: Not all incumbents perform all of the duties described below but perform a similar range of duties as per the directive of the Team Leader/ Director of Day Services.

ACCOUNTABILITIES:

1. Safety

• Ensure that members and staff work in a safe environment.

• Ensure compliance with all safety rules and regulations are being adhered to by all, including but not limited to, emergency evacuation procedures, vehicle usage, transportation of members, working alone, food, medications and equipment, storage and maintenance.

• Answer door and telephone during shift using proper precautions.

• Provide crisis intervention for members as required.

• Ensure an active watch over both the members and the facility through the course of regular duties.

• Understand and promote members’ rights and responsibilities.

• Provide transportation to and from various locations while demonstrating safe driving skills.

• Follow all traffic laws while driving defensively to ensure safety.

• Report concerns promptly to Director as needed.

• Ensure proper lifting, twisting and reaching techniques are used during job performance.

• Remain alert and awake at all times, throughout all shifts.

• Use PPE provided when necessary

2. Health and Medical

• Ensure individual’s health and medical needs are accurately attended to in a timely fashion including personal care where needed, and that all medication is properly administered and recorded.

• Recognize and report concerns of abuse or neglect.

• Provide emotional support for members as required.

• Ensure meals and snacks are varied, attractive, nutritionally, and calorically adequate for the dietary and medical requirements of each member as recommended in the current Canadian Dietary Standard.

3. Person Centred Plans

• Be involved in implementing individual plans.

• Communicate necessary information, observations and concerns with the Director.

• Provide individuals with support by gathering information on an individual’s goals and desired outcomes.

4. Individual Personal Development

• Encourage and assist each individual to participate in daily activities in their program and community environments including reinforcing all expectations.

• Ensure that the environment of the program is supportive, nurturing, and encourages a high degree of member involvement including decision making.

• Role model appropriate behaviour and attitude supporting growth and promoting independence for the members.

5. Public Relations and Communication

• Develop opportunities for relationships with families and the community and assist individuals’ to develop positive social interactions.

• Ensure all contact with others is courteous and professional.

• Treat all members and other staff with respect and dignity at all times.

6. Program Development

• Collaboratively create, manage and facilitate appropriate individual and group activities, special events and spiritual care programs according to member interest, skill and ability levels.

• Promote social interaction and personal development.

• Ensure all necessary components and any required documentation is completed for assigned activities.

• Participate in ongoing program assessment, review and evaluation of all programs.

7. Other Duties as Required

WORKING CONDITIONS:
• The incumbent’s typical work environment is a day program facility, with significant amounts of work accompanying members in the community.

• The incumbent may be initially assigned to one location but may be transferred or redeployed to another location as needed, including adjustments to their designated start location.

• Working conditions may be isolated, may, dealing with verbal abuse and angry and/or abusive people.

• Overnight or out-of-town business travel is not typically expected.

• Moderate exposure to hazards: domestic cleaning supplies; handling of waste (garbage), bodily fluids/wastes, sharp objects, dirt/dust/odor, hot equipment (ovens, stoves, etc.).

• Minor to moderate exposure to hazards: physical attack from members, and traffic accidents when driving

• Minor exposure to hazards: infectious diseases, toxic chemicals, scabies, lice and/or bed bugs, emergency response situations (fire, bomb threat, etc.) and other potentially dangerous situations

The above responsibilities must be performed in keeping with The Salvation Army’s Mission, Vision and Values, in a professional manner, upholding our code of conduct.

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:
• Completed high school, grade 12 or the equivalent

• An equivalent combination of education and experience may be acceptable

• Valid Manitoba Class 5F driver license

• Certified Winnipeg Police or RCMP Criminal record check including Vulnerable Sector completed

• Province of Manitoba Child Abuse Registry check
• Province of Manitoba Adult Abuse Registry check

Experience and Skilled Knowledge Requirements

• Suitable candidates may be hired without previous experience; however, prior related experience will be considered an asset on hiring.

Skills and Capabilities

• Occasional to moderate amount of keyboarding/manual record keeping • Occasional to moderate amounts of physical care (including manual or assisted transfers)

• Moderate lifting/packing of member belongings or program supplies Frequent standing, sitting, walking, & reaching

• Moderate amount of light housekeeping and property maintenance

• Occasional use of physical behaviour intervention techniques

• Attentive listening & observation of body language

• Continuously monitoring the environment

• Basic reading, writing, arithmetic, and computer skills

• Significant memory & concentration

• Significant reasoning & judgment

• Ability to understand members’ needs

• Frequent multi-tasking

• Moderate to significant creativity and imagination

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team

• Excellent team and interpersonal skills

• Fluent spoken and written English

• Able to handle the physical demands, which include lifting/carrying of items up to 40 pounds.

This is a regular full-time position

Weekly scheduled hours: 40

Compensation:

Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as market conditions, internal equity, and candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role.

title: Full Stack Developer - Lovable & Supabase

  • Manage and work with code hosted on GitHub, ensuring a clean and maintainable development setup

  • Work with booking, calendar-based, and other workflow-driven functionality where required

  • Strong experience with Supabase or similar backend, database, and authentication platforms

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to quickly understand an existing technical setup

  • Comfortable working independently and taking full technical ownership of a product
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable working in an early-stage, founder-led environment with a high level of ambiguity and ownership
  • Strong attention to detail, reliability, and a practical approach to solving technical problems

Vår forretningsplan har vis seg å være rett og vårt hovedfokus på våre medarbeidere og våre varer viser seg å være vår nøkkel til suksess. Som en del av organisasjonen i ONLY Stores kan du i høy grad få det ansvaret du ønsker, de oppgaver du brenner for, og ikke minst være en del av et fantastisk team.

Gjennom våre verdier jobber vi målrettet og strukturert for å nå målene våre.

Winning Mentality - Nearness - Founder's Mentality - Business Mindset - Passion and Hard Work

Hos ONLY Stores vet vi at de medarbeidere som har disse verdiene gjør en stor forskjell!

Jobben

Som deltid selger hos oss så forventer vi at du kjenner deg igjen i verdiene våre, er glad i et høyt tempo hvor ingen dag er lik og ønsker å være en del av og en bidragsyter til teamet ditt. Mote og trender er noe som interesserer deg og du er opptatt av å følge med i markedet.

Har du høyt tempo, konkurranseinstinkt, og du er klar for å ta i et tak! Er du en team player som kan bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø og jobbe sammen med teamet for å nå målene vi setter oss? Mener du også at kunden alltid kommer først? Da vil vi høre fra deg!

Stillingen er en sommervikar stilling som vil innebære dag, kveld og helger.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Om oss

ONLY Stores er en del av BESTSELLER Retail Europe vi har eksisteret i mer enn 25 år og driver konseptbutikker under følgende brands: ONLY, ONLY & SONS & JDY.

Vi har base i Brande, hvor vi er 40 dedikerede kollegaer, som beskjeftiger oss med drift av butikker. Vi driver BESTSELLER Retail Europe ut fra ledelsesmessige verdier, som bygger på fremgang for enhver pris, nærhet til våre kollegaer og butikker og en uskuelig tro på, at vi kan gjøre det enda bedre i morgen.

Vi arbeider i et sterkt konkurransemessig miljø, hvor vår innsats og innstilling gir resultater direkte på bunnlinjen. Vi hyller prinsippet om frihet under ansvar, og vi elsker mennesker som tar initiativ og som gjør en forskjell. Vi tror på, at det er den måte vi best utvikler vår forretning og hverandre.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
location: New City, New York, United States
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in New City, New York.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the New City area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near New City requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Planner I
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

  • Develop and maintain production plans based on business requirements on an ad hoc basis.
  • Monitor raw material availability and supplier delivery schedules, and adjust production plans accordingly.
  • Maintain and update MPC/PP-related data.
  • Calculate machine and manpower capacity loading.
  • Track production plan execution and shipment performance.
  • Analyze and report work order closure yield and production efficiency on the manufacturing lines.
  • Support the supervisor in achieving departmental KPIs and handling other assigned tasks.
  • Coordinate planning-related activities for WCM Sales & Operations Meetings (S&OP) and Material Planning weekly meetings.
  • Complete tasks assigned by the supervisor and handle related exceptions and issues in a timely manner.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • At least 2 years of experience in Production Planning, Material Planning, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP systems is required.
  • Familiar with production planning processes, production scheduling, and material planning control (MPC).
  • Good command of Chinese; candidates with good English listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills will also be an advantage.
  • Detail-oriented, accuracy-focused, and possessing a strong safety awareness.
  • Able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and maintain good 5S workplace practices.

Working Time: Monday - Friday (8h - 17h)

Location: Nhon Trach, Dong Nai

title: Intern - Global Project Management (DDS)
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking an Intern – Global Project Management (DDS) to join our team in Singapore

Internship Details:

  • Duration: at least 20 weeks, full-time (Onsite)
  • Dates of Internship: Jan – Jun 2027
  • Compensation: Paid internship
  • Eligibility: Final-year students who are expected to graduate in Jul/Aug 2027 are preferred. However, students at all academic levels who are pursuing relevant fields of study are encouraged to apply.

About Team:

The Asia Pacific Diagnostic Development Service (DDS) team at Labcorp Central Laboratory Services is responsible for successful study management and delivery of all central laboratory operations with companion diagnostic part of global clinical studies. Acting as a liaison with device clients in relationship with pharma clients or their representatives and other teams in Labcorp to provide outstanding client satisfaction.

Internship Assignment Summary:

  • Understand the Labcorp Central Laboratory Services (CLS) scope of services to pharmaceutical clients and client representatives
  • Understand the different Project Management roles within Labcorp CLS and their scope of work
  • Understand the responsibilities of other Labcorp CLS departments involved in the clinical study
  • Understand the roles and responsibilities of Senior Regional CDx Study Manager to regional study related activities including responding and resolving challenges in logistics, monitoring study supplies, lab tests resulting and sample management
  • Understand Senior Regional CDx Study Manager’s support as a regional liaison between Labcorp Central Lab Services (CLS) and Global Study Manager and various CLS departments from study setup to closure

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Current enrollment in Life Sciences, Medical Sciences, Biochemistry, or other related Bachelor's degree programs. Other degree programs can also be considered
  • Has experience delivering multiple projects in an academic or professional setting.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Able to organize data and documents effectively.
  • Demonstrates the ability to communicate and collaborate with stakeholders and internal/external colleagues
  • Have the “can-do” and proactive mindset when resolving issues.

Additional Job Standards:

  • Good organization and multitasking ability.
  • Able to communicate effectively with excellent verbal/written communication skills.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Creative and self-motivated individuals who work collaboratively in a high-performance team environment.

About the Program As a Labcorp intern, you’ll be immersed in hands-on work that complements your academic background. In addition to your project work, you’ll gain valuable exposure to Labcorp’s global business, culture, and leadership through:

  • Enterprise-wide learning experiences that introduce you to key business functions across Labcorp
  • Leadership exposure and visibility, including direct interaction with senior leaders
  • An immersive, in-person Workshops designed to connect you with peers and deepen your understanding of our mission
  • Senior leader speaker sessions offering insights into strategy, innovation, and career growth
  • Continuous opportunities to connect and grow, from intern cohort communication channels and LinkedIn Learning resources to professional development sessions and storytelling opportunities that highlight your internship journey
  • Connection to Labcorp’s inclusive culture through engagement with our employee resource groups (ERGs)and values-driven community initiatives
  • Dedicated mentoring connections to guide your growth, provide career advice, and support your internship journey

Apply now to launch your career and create real impact for patients worldwide. #FutureofLabcorp

At Labcorp we have a passion for helping people live happy and healthy lives. Every day we provide vital information that helps our clients and patients understand their health. If you are passionate about helping people and have a drive for service, then Labcorp could be a great next career step!

title: Gas Station Part Time
description:
A World-Class Team

BJ’s Wholesale Club is powered by more than 30,000 team members who make a real impact every day. Whether you're stocking shelves, solving problems or shaping strategy, your work helps families save on what matters most.

We’re a team built on purpose and opportunity. Join us and be part of something meaningful.

Why You’ll Love Working at BJ’s

At BJ’s Wholesale Club, our team members are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being and future – both on and off the job. When you grow, we grow.

Here’s just some of what you can look forward to:

  • Weekly Pay: Get paid every week so that you can manage your money on your terms.
  • Free BJ’s Memberships: Enjoy a complimentary The Club Card Membership, plus a free Supplemental Membership for someone in your household.*
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Take the time you need with vacation, personal, sick days, holidays, bereavement, and jury duty leave.*
  • Flexible and Affordable Health Benefits: Choose from three medical plans, and access optional dental, vision, Health Savings Account (HSA), and flexible spending account options to fit your lifestyle.*
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan: Build your financial future with a company match (available to team members 18 and older).*
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan: Accumulate funds through after-tax payroll deductions that can be used to purchase shares of BJ’s common stock at a 15% discount.*

*Eligibility requirements vary by position.

Job Summary

Responsible for the daily operation of the gas station, performing opening and closing procedures, monitoring and maintaining gas station equipment, assisting members with gas station transactions and payments, and complying with safety, environmental and security standards.

Major Tasks, Responsibilities, and Key Accountabilities

  • Provides exceptional member service and promptly assists members as needed. Ensures the safety of people, property and environment while assisting members with gas station transactions.
  • Responsible for monitoring gas station sales transactions and handling cash transactions when applicable.
  • Maintain cleanliness standards of restrooms; custodial duties as needed.
  • Monitors gas station reporting, ensures reports are generated, and performs gas station checklist procedures. Properly documents and addresses identified issues.
  • Accurately performs all opening and closing procedures.
  • Regularly monitors and maintains gas station equipment.
  • Oversees the fuel delivery process and performs required preparation procedures.
  • Understands the safety and security features of the gas station and complies with safety, environmental and security standards. Informs management and help desk when any alarms are present.
  • Performs cash drawer procedures including cash deposit, verification, documentation and control procedures.
  • Performs competitive price surveys daily and ensures posted gas prices and club signage match the pricing in the POS (point of sale) system
  • Understands and properly follows all spill bucket and spilled material procedures including immediate response and clean up procedures at the gas station.
  • Logs all visitors and obtains proper ID before allowing anyone inside the kiosk area. Notifies corporate office of any non-routine maintenance vendor visits including, but not limited to, weights and measures, inspectors and state employees.
  • Maintains all club policies and procedures.
  • Performs other duties as assigned, including working in other departments as needed.
  • Regular, predictable, full attendance is an essential function of this job.

Qualifications

  • Previous gas station operating experience preferred.
  • Experience operating a cash register preferred.
  • Must be able to complete all required training.
  • At least 18 years of age.

Environmental Job Conditions

  • Exposure to both indoor and outdoor temperatures and weather conditions.
  • May require occasional lifting up to 50 lbs.
  • Could require long periods of sitting/standing and some bending.
  • Occasional exposure to flammable liquids and strong smells.

Team Members:

  • Carry out job functions and responsibilities as assigned. Support the application of club policies, procedures and compliance.
  • We strive for flawless execution and hold ourselves accountable .
  • Acts with honesty and integrity and lead with the member in mind to address any and all concerns and to escalate any concerns, as appropriate.
  • Ensure a safe and positive environment for our members and each other.
  • Embrace inclusion and diversity, by working together with collaboration and respect. Work as a team to achieve goals.
  • Move with speed and agility in everything we do.
  • Innovate and adapt so we can move as fast as the world around us.
  • Maintain a friendly and positive attitude.

Members:

  • Deliver service excellence through all points of contact.
  • Resolve and deescalate to address every member concern.
  • Ensure a safe and positive environment and experience for the members.
  • Daily commitment to GOLD Member Standards
    • Greet, Anticipate, Appreciate (GAA)
    • Fast, Friendly Full, Fresh, Clean

Club Standards: Work as a team to deliver GOLD club standards daily.

  • Work with commitment and pride to deliver GOLD- Grand opening look daily
    • All items stocked and promotional plans executed
    • Maintain visible accurate signage
    • Clean and organized, inside and out

Know your Business:

  • Understand how to access and read production and/or financial performance reporting for your department
  • See the connection between consistent execution and the positive impact it can have on the business

In accordance with the Pay Transparency requirements, the following represents a good faith estimate of the compensation range for this position. At BJ’s Wholesale Club, we carefully consider a wide range of non-discriminatory factors when determining salary. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, education, experience, and qualifications. The pay range for this position is $16.50 - $19.80

We recognize the growing role of AI tools, including ChatGPT, and value familiarity with them. That said, we want to hear from your authentic self. Your application should reflect your own skills, experiences, and insights rather than AI-generated responses.

title: Privatrådgiver til Jyske Bank i Lyngby
description:
I Jyske Bank kæmper vi for menneskers økonomiske tryghed og handlekraft. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes tæt på kunden og med udgangspunkt i det liv, kunden lever.

Nu søger vi en privatrådgiver til Lyngby.

Vi søger dig, som har minimum 1-2 års erfaring med rådgivning af privatkunder og er klar til at tage ansvar for egne kunderelationer i en afdeling med godt sammenhold, høj faglighed og stor frihed.

Det får du hos os

Som privatrådgiver i Lyngby får du:

  • Ansvar for egne kunder og mulighed for at levere rådgivning, som skaber værdi
  • Frihed til at finde de løsninger, der giver bedst mening for kunden
  • Tillid og ansvar frem for detailstyring
  • Dygtige kolleger og specialister tæt på
  • Fleksibilitet og indflydelse på egen hverdag

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
location: Clifton Park, New York, United States
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Clifton Park, New York.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Clifton Park area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Clifton Park requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

Job Title: Intelligence Monitoring Specialist
Location: Arlington, VA
Clearance Level: Top Secret / SCI Eligibility - Must have Clearance to Start

Job Description

The Intelligence Monitoring Specialist (Open Source Research Specialist III) position provides preliminary warning on/awareness of classified intelligence reporting to ensure U.S. diplomatic facilities, personnel abroad, and other key stakeholders are informed about potential threats from terrorism, political violence, and crime. It is responsible for monitoring classified intelligence, determining whether it meets criteria for warning, and disseminating relevant notifications to operational stakeholders. This role is based within a 24x7 Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility, requiring a Top Secret/SCI clearance to begin work. The position requires and will be assigned to shift work, including regular overnight, weekend, and holiday work, with work hours to be determined based on needs of the office.
Responsibilities/Duties:
  • Monitor Classified Intelligence. Continuously review and research classified cable traffic and other intelligence reporting to identify potential direct and indirect threats relevant to U.S. diplomatic facilities and personnel, as well as to other U.S. interests overseas. Maintain situational awareness based on classified reporting during breaking events overseas.
  • Evaluate Dissemination Criteria. Assess classified intelligence to determine whether it meets predefined threat criteria for dissemination to operational stakeholders.
  • Disseminate Threat Intelligence. Quickly generate and distribute short, templated threat notifications to overseas security personnel, domestic desk officers and analysts, and external agencies.
  • Support Data Calls/Requests for Information. Answer requests for information from Senior Watch Officers, office management, and other partners while staying within the bounds of mission requirements. As needed, may provide information in both written and oral briefing formats.
  • Databases and Information Logging. Maintain classified and unclassified data logs for disseminated notifications and leverage intelligence toolkits and databases to support threat warning operations.
  • Conduct Cross-Network Operations. Monitor reporting on a TS/SCI network while disseminating information through a Secret network.
  • Manage Workload. Operate autonomously, managing time effectively while adhering to established processes and procedures.
  • Collaborate with Stakeholders. Work closely with colleagues and organizational partners to obtain and share security-related intelligence, ensuring timely awareness of relevant threat reporting."

Education and Background

  • Bachelor's degree plus 4 years of relevant experience, or 7+ years of experience without a degree.

Required Skills

  • Prior experience monitoring, researching, and disseminating security and/or threat-related intelligence reporting, particularly in a U.S. government or Department of State context.
  • Strong ability to identify relevant intelligence and generate accurate, timely, concise synopses of reports.
  • Ability to follow established processes, procedures, and written templates.
  • Proficiency in databases and tools used to access and disseminate classified information.
  • Strong skills in oral and written communication to present clear, concise information overviews.
  • Ability to manage time and work independently to achieve assigned tasks, while also taking direction from both mid- and senior-level supervisors responsible for management of complementary information-sharing missions.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, capable of working effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Highly collaborative, with the ability to interact effectively and professionally with individuals at all levels.
  • Customer service mindset, with a strong desire to meet customer needs within established mission parameters."

Preferred Skills

  • Previous experience working on a watch floor, particularly if involved in threat warning and/or intelligence operations.
  • Familiarity with Department of State and other U.S. government agency missions, databases, search platforms, and/or information handling systems."

Working Conditions

Typical Office Environment.

In addition, Agile Defense invests in its employees beyond just compensation. Agile’s benefits offerings include, dependent upon position, Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, Holiday Pay, short-term and long-term Disability, Retirement and Learning and Development opportunities as well as other optional benefit elections.

Our Core Values
Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together.
What makes us Agile? We call it the 6Hs, the values that define our culture and guide everything we do. Together, these values infuse vibrancy, integrity, and a tireless work ethic into advancing the most important national security and critical civilian missions. It's how we show up every day. It's who we are.
  • Happy - Be Infectious. Happiness multiplies and creates a positive and connected environment where motivation and satisfaction have an outsized effect on everything we do.
  • Helpful - Be Supportive. Being helpful is the foundation of teamwork, resulting in a supportive atmosphere where collaboration flourishes, and collective success is celebrated.
  • Honest - Be Trustworthy. Honesty serves as our compass, ensuring transparent communication and ethical conduct, essential to who we are and the complex domains we support.
  • Humble - Be Grounded. Success is not achieved alone, humility ensures a culture of mutual respect, encouraging open communication, and a willingness to learn from one another and take on any task.
  • Hungry - Be Eager. Our hunger for excellence drives an insatiable appetite for innovation and continuous improvement, propelling us forward in the face of new and unprecedented challenges.
  • Hustle - Be Driven. Hustle is reflected in our relentless work ethic, where we are each committed to going above and beyond to advance the mission and achieve success.

title: Ambitiøs Indskolingsleder til Byskolen i Nakskov
description:
Har du lyst og kompetencer til at træde ind i skolens ledelse og være med til at forme en central lederstilling, hvor du får direkte indflydelse på hverdagen, trivsel samt den faglige og pædagogiske linje? Så er du måske vores nye Indskolingsleder på Byskolen.

Som afdelingsleder for indskolingen på Byskolen står du i spidsen for fundamentet i elevernes skoleliv. Vi søger en leder, der kan sætte en tydelig pædagogisk linje for udviklingen i SFO og Indskolingen.

Du bliver en del af et ambitiøst og tæt samarbejdende ledelsesteam på en velfungerende skole med ca. 400 elever og 60 medarbejdere. Her står du ikke alene med ledelsesopgaven.

Vi sætter retning sammen, udfordrer og udvikler hinandens ledelsespraksis – og giver samtidig plads til, at du sætter dit eget præg på både hverdagen og skolens fortsatte udvikling.

Vi leder efter dig, der på empatisk vis har et klart blik for faglig udvikling og pædagogisk ledelse og dig, der både kan motivere og rådgive dygtige medarbejdere og skabe tydelige rammer for elevernes læring og trivsel.

Et ledelsesteam med blik for både fælles retning og individuel udvikling

Som en del af ledelsesteamet på Byskolen træder du ind i et forpligtende og udviklingsorienteret fællesskab. Vi arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe en tydelig pædagogisk retning og høj kvalitet i skolens læringsmiljøer – men vi arbejder også aktivt med at udvikle hinandens ledelsespraksis. Gennem fælles refleksion, sparring og løbende dialog udfordrer og inspirerer vi hinanden til at blive endnu skarpere i vores roller som ledere. Vi tror på, at stærk ledelse smitter af i hele organisationen.

Du bliver en del af et team på tre, hvor forskellighed er en styrke, og hvor ambitioner går hånd i hånd med nysgerrighed, humor og åbenhed. Her får du kolleger, der ikke kun vil skolen det bedste – men også vil dig det bedste som leder.

Hvorfor vælge Byskolen

Vi arbejder på, at Folkeskolen i Nakskov skal blive det aktive tilvalg for vores familier.

Du skal hjælpe os med at skabe en endnu bedre skole for flere. Ikke kun for elever med særlige forudsætninger, men for alle vores elever.

Vi har store ambitioner for både elever og hinanden og har i de seneste år investeret målrettet i at kompetenceudvikle vores lærere og pædagoger, og videreudvikle en skole, hvor trivsel, læring og udvikling går hånd i hånd.

På Byskolen lægger vi vægt på at inddrage elevernes perspektiv og arbejder med at give rum til deres stemme i læringsfællesskabet. Vi tror på, at stærke relationer er fundamentet for trivsel og læring – og at vores nærvær kan gøre hele forskellen i den enkeltes læring.

Hos os får du mulighed for at indgå i en spændende hverdag fyldt med ca. 400 elever og en bred medarbejdergruppe, som arbejder tæt sammen om børnenes faglige, sociale og personlige udvikling.

Fra kommende skoleår er vi forpligtet på både nye fagplaner og teknologiforståelse. En udvikling der kommer i naturlig forlængelse af skoleudviklingen, men også en udvikling, hvor vi sammen skal sætte spørgsmålstegn ved eksisterende praksis. Vi uddanner flere læse- og matematikvejledere til at understøtte vores undervisere i hverdagen.

Vi tror på, at det gode arbejdsmiljø og samarbejde skaber de bedste rammer – også når opgaverne er komplekse. Derfor søger vi en ny kollega i ledelsesteamet, som forstår værdien af at arbejde tæt på praksis, være medskaber af en tydelig faglig retning og bidrage aktivt til både hverdag og udviklingsarbejde.

Samtidigt står vi overfor nye udfordringer i skolestrukturen i Lolland Kommune, som vi allerede nu sammen med vores kolleger på de øvrige skoler samarbejder om at finde gode løsninger på. Det fælles tværfaglige samspil er en vigtig ressource. Vi er spændt på, hvordan du kan se dig ind i dette ledelsesfelt.

Lidt om Byskolen

Byskolen ligger midt i Nakskov. Vi er en skole med 2 spor på alle årgange fra 0. -10 årgang. Vi er en stor medarbejdergruppe på 60 ansatte. Uanset vores faglige baggrund så er vores fælles opgave at sikre, at der bliver taget hånd om læring i fællesksabet, så der skabes størst mulighed for, at alle udvikler sig så meget som muligt både, fagligt, personligt og socialt.

Undervisningen foregår på 3 forskellige matrikler, placeret omkring jernbanen i Nakskov. Indskolingen bor i en moderne, lav bygning ved siden af Nakskov Idrætscenter. Mellemtrin og Udskoling bor på Nørrevold og 10.klasserne bor på Campus Nakskov. Byskolen har almenklasser, SFO, erhvervsklasse og visiterede specialklasser. Desuden arbejder vi med flere typer af mellemformer/forstærket undervisning, for at sikre de bedste deltagelsesmuligheder for vores elever.

Dine opgaver og rolle er, at
  • bidrage til det fælles ledelsesarbejde i ledelsesteamet
  • faglig, pædagogisk ledelse med fokus på SFO og Indskolingen
  • personaleledelse i SFO og Indskolingen
  • skabe fælles faglig retning med blik for både elevernes og medarbejdernes behov
  • Sparring og supervision med lærere og pædagoger
  • være en synlig og tilgængelig leder tæt på undervisningen og elevernes fritidstilbud

Vi forventer, at du
  • er uddannet lærer eller pædagog
  • har en Diplom i ledelse eller er indstillet på at påbegynde uddannelsen

Vi lægger vægt på, at du
  • har evnen til at arbejde struktueret, lede processer og kommunikere klart
  • har en tillidsvækkende, lyttende og anerkendende tilgang til både elever, forældre og medarbejdere og kollegaer
  • er nysgerrig på andre mennesker og kan være engangeret i store og små opgaver
  • trives i en hverdag med forandringer

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn efter gældende overenskomst og efter principperne om lokal løndannelse.

Stillingen forventes indplaceret inden for et samlet løninterval på ca. 46.243,46 – 47.431,72 kr. månedligt ekskl. pension og tillæg. Hertil kommer pension på 17,30 % + 1,70 % i fritvalgstillæg. Herudover vil der være mulighed for forhandling af individuelle tillæg baseret på relevante kompetencer.

Der indhentes børne- og straffeattest ved ansættelse.

Tiltrædelse 1.december 2026 eller tidligere.

Ansøgningsproces

Ansøgningsfrist er d. 1.oktober 2026.

Der afholdes to samtalerunder.

Samtaler vil blive afholdt d. 7. og d. 21.oktober.

Kandidater til 2. samtale bedes gennemføre en personprofilanalyse.

Nysgerrig?

Du er velkommen til at kontakte skoleleder Betina Siegvardsen på 51 80 02 96 for mere information eller aftale et besøg.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så glæder vi os til at læse din ansøgning – og byde dig velkommen i et varmt, fagligt stærkt og ambitiøst fællesskab!

I Lolland Kommune arbejder omkring 3.500 medarbejdere hver dag for at skabe værdi for borgerne og udvikle kommunen. Medarbejderne er nøglen til udviklingen og til en arbejdsplads præget af dialog, åbenhed og nytænkning. Derfor investerer vi målrettet i kompetencer, nye arbejdsformer og stærke karrieremuligheder.

Med en placering tæt på Tyskland, Sjælland og Fyn er Lolland samtidig et attraktivt sted at bo. Her får du gode forbindelser til resten af landet, aktive lokalsamfund, idylliske købstæder og storslået natur. Her er plads til både arbejde og fritid – og til en hverdag, der hænger sammen.

Læs mere om at arbejde og bo i Lolland Kommune på Lolland Kommune som arbejdsplads

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Olney, Maryland.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Olney area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Olney requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: SUPERSELGER I 60% STILLING PÅ ONLY KNARVIK
description:
Vil du bli med på reisen?

​

ONLY Stores er i sterk utvikling, og vi søker derfor en ambisiøs superselger som kan bidra til en utvikling av vår butikk på ONLY KNARVIK.

​

Bli en del av ONLY Stores

ONLY Stores har vært på en forrykende reise gjennom de siste fem år, og vi er langt fra ferdige med reisen. Vår forretningsplan har vist seg å være riktig. Vi har hatt vårt primærfokus på to ting – våre produkter og våre medarbeidere. Som en del av organisasjonen i ONLY Stores kan du i høy grad få det ansvaret du ønsker, de oppgaver du brenner for, og ikke minst være en del av et fantastisk team.

Hos ONLY Stores vet vi at våre medarbeidere gjør en stor forskjell!

​

Jobben

Som 60% selger hos oss så forventer vi at du kjenner deg igjen i verdiene våre, er glad i et høyt tempo hvor ingen dag er lik og ønsker å være en del av og en bidragsyter til teamet ditt. Mote og trender er noe som interesserer deg og du er opptatt av å følge med i markedet.

Har du høyt tempo, konkurranseinstinkt, og du er klar for å ta i et tak! Er du en team player som kan bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø og jobbe sammen med teamet for å nå målene vi setter oss? Mener du også at kunden alltid kommer først? Da vil vi høre fra deg!

Stillingen vil innebære dag, kveld og helger, men vi har også behov for at du kan stille opp ekstra ved sykdom, varetelling og ferieavvikling.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Konkret vil dine arbeidsoppgaver innebære:

  • Jobbe med egne nøkkeltall daglig
  • Merchandising
  • Oppgjør
  • Varetelling
  • Ansvar for butikken/personale når butikkleder er på ferie/syk

Din profil

Du kjenner retailbransjen innenfra og du har en naturlig interesse for mote. Du er en person med høy grad av energi, har sans for detaljer, og du tør å sette retningen. Det er viktig at du er utadvendt i din arbeidsstil , og du er i stand til å skape et solid nettverk. Du er god på og skape team og øke kompetansen til de rundt deg.

​

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

​

Om oss

ONLY Stores er en del av BESTSELLER Retail Europe vi har eksisteret i mer enn 25 år og driver konseptbutikker under følgende brands: ONLY, ONLY & SONS & JDY.

Vi har base i Brande, hvor vi er 40 dedikerede kollegaer, som beskjeftiger oss med drift av butikker. Vi driver BESTSELLER Retail Europe ut fra ledelsesmessige verdier, som bygger på fremgang for enhver pris, nærhet til våre kollegaer og butikker og en uskuelig tro på, at vi kan gjøre det enda bedre i morgen.

Vi arbeider i et sterkt konkurransemessig miljø, hvor vår innsats og innstilling gir resultater direkte på bunnlinjen. Vi hyller prinsippet om frihet under ansvar, og vi elsker mennesker som tar initiativ og som gjør en forskjell. Vi tror på, at det er den måte vi best utvikler vår forretning og hverandre.

Job Description:

Positively impact the lives of youth in the care of the Department of Juvenile Justice through the collaborative creation and maintenance of a safe, therapeutic, and educational environment in facilities. Provide support, guidance, and structure for our detained youth by modeling, encouraging, and reinforcing pro-social behaviors to include patience, empathy, cooperation, professionalism, and respect. Supervises, guides and/or instructs the work assignments of subordinate staff. Assists shift supervisor with administration of the facility.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Assumes responsibility for the custody, security, and care of youth through adherence to policies and standard operating procedures governing the Georgia Department of Juvenile Justice.

  • Ensures the provision of direct support, guidance, and structure for detained youth with an emphasis on safety, personal conduct, care, and rehabilitation

  • Completes administrative paperwork, preparation and maintenance of records, forms and report.

  • Inspects, inventories, and maintains control of various security equipment and technology to successfully support the safety and well-being of juveniles served in facilities.

  • Maintains order and discipline by intervening with youth through active supervision and controlling inappropriate youth behavior to maintain a safe and secure environment. Provides support in training, selecting, and orienting subordinate correctional security staff.

  • Reads and reviews youth information to identify issues that require special attention. Oversees officer activities and performance to ensure that the custody, security, and welfare of youth is maintained.

  • Position may serve as the Shift Supervisor in the absence of the Lieutenant.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma/GED and six (6) months of experience as a Juvenile Correctional Officer 3 (PSP222) or equivalent.

  • Must successfully complete Leadership Core Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced within the first six months of employment.

  • Or four (4) years of military experience

  • Must possess and maintain State of Georgia P.O.S.T. certification within the first six (6) months of employment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Preference will be given to applicants who, in addition to meeting the minimum qualifications, possess one or more of the following:

  • Current and valid certification as a Juvenile Correctional Officer by the Georgia Peace Officer Standards and Training (POST) Council

  • One or more years of experience in a Juvenile Justice environment

  • Completion of one or more years of college

Military Salary Increase Incentive Amount:

  • 2.5% for one year of active-duty service

  • 5% for two years of active-duty service

  • 7.5% for three years of active-duty service

  • 10% for 4+ years of active-duty service

In addition to a competitive salary & benefits, GA Department of Juvenile Justice is part of a statewide initiative called Total Rewards that seeks to attract and retain employees by supplementing their base pay and benefits with programs designed to improve the quality of their work environment and lead to greater job satisfaction and work/life balance. description:

Job Description:

We are GDIT—supporting and securing some of the most complex government, defense, and intelligence projects in the country. We ensure today is safe and tomorrow is smarter, with work that has real impact. GDIT is your place to own your career by embracing autonomy, seizing opportunity, and being trusted to deliver your best.

As the Network Engineering Technical Lead, you will support an IT Service Management contract that operates, modernizes, and evolves the ARNG’s global IT services, including networking, compute, storage, infrastructure, applications, hosting, and program management. This program underpins ARNG’s enterprise IT infrastructure, WAN, authentication and directory services, cybersecurity, application hosting, and related services, using ITIL as the basis for its IT Service Management (ITSM) model. A current, active Secret clearance is required.

How a Network Engineering Technical Lead Will Make an Impact

  • Lead, mentor, and direct an integrated engineering team in the architecture, design, implementation, and modernization of the DoDIN-A(NG) and DoDIN-A(NG)-S enterprise networks.

  • Prepare and review comprehensive engineering solutions, architecture design documents, and implementation plans for complex ARNG strategic initiatives.

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor to government and military leadership; develop and deliver executive-level briefings on engineering solutions, system issues, and corrective actions.

  • Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major network incidents and outages, establishing and defending corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

  • Perform enterprise architecture and technology gap analyses, recommending strategic improvements to DoDIN-A(NG) and DoDIN-A(NG)-S operations, security, and scalability.

  • Oversee implementation and sustainment of DISA STIG baselines, ensuring continuous compliance for CORA inspections and ATO renewals across all network assets.

  • Develop, review, and defend complex change requests before the Change Configuration Board (CCB) and govern enterprise Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

  • Design, plan, and validate secure, resilient data communication networks incorporating Cisco routers, Layer 3 switches, Palo Alto firewalls, IDS/IPS systems, and in-line encryptors.

  • Evaluate and integrate emerging communications and software-defined networking technologies; conduct trade studies and proof-of-concept testing to advance network capabilities.

  • Coordinate across cross-functional teams and with vendors on technical engagements to ensure cohesive solution delivery.

  • Support Future Operations to evaluate technologies that advance Army Unified Network Plan (AUNP) objectives, automation, AI integration, and other efforts to modernize service operations.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 10+ years of experience in network engineering and technology integration in large, global environments.

  • 4+ years of technical leadership experience managing engineering projects and delegating tasks to team members.

  • 8+ years of progressive enterprise network engineering experience with Cisco and Palo Alto routing, switching, IDS/IPS, and firewall technologies, including at least 4+ years in a technical lead role.

Skills & Additional Requirements

  • Expertise in advanced routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), MPLS, VPN architectures, Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), and IDS/IPS policy engineering.

  • Expertise with 802.1X / Comply to Connect (C2C) technologies (ForeScout and/or Cisco ISE).

  • Ability to identify automation opportunities, evaluate solutions, and lead engineering and implementation activities.

  • Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale network engineering solutions within DoD environments.

  • Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams, setting technical standards, assigning tasks, and conducting peer design reviews.

  • Strong briefing and communication skills, with experience presenting technical solutions, problem reports, and corrective actions to senior military and government leadership.

  • Deep knowledge of securing and hardening network devices in compliance with DISA STIGs, CORA frameworks, and DoD cybersecurity directives.

  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills; able to lead troubleshooting on high-visibility enterprise issues and drive decisive corrective actions.

  • Strong documentation skills, including authorship of Architecture Design Documents, Engineering Implementation Plans, SOPs, and technical white papers.

  • Self-motivated, adaptable to shifting priorities, and effective at managing multiple high-priority engineering workstreams.

  • Commitment to continuous technical growth and maintaining advanced industry certifications.

Certification Requirements

  • Two certifications required:

    • Baseline certification meeting DoD 8570.01-M / DoD 8140 IAT Level II (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE) or IAT Level III (e.g., CASP+ CE, CISSP) prior to start.

    • Professional-level Computing Environment (CE) certification (e.g., Cisco CCNA, Juniper JNCIA, or Palo Alto Networks PCNSE) prior to start.

  • When 8140 requirements are implemented on the program/contract, employee must conform to updated 8140 certification standards.

Clearance Requirements

  • Active Secret clearance at time of interview, with ability to maintain clearance.

  • Ability to obtain TS/SCI eligibility.

Work Location

  • Fairview Park, Falls Church, VA.

  • Three (3) days onsite and up to two (2) days telework.

  • Onboarding/transition period may require up to 90 days fully onsite. ENOCS work schedules are subject to change based on mission requirements from GDIT or Government leadership.

Travel

  • Less than 10%.


GDIT IS YOUR PLACE
At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.
● Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
● Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
● Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off
● Flexibility: Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home ***remove if ineligible***
● Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY
Explore an enterprise IT career at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your desire to drive operations forward.

The likely salary range for this position is $161,500 - $218,500. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

40

Less than 10%

Onsite

USA VA Falls Church

Total Rewards at GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identity Verification Process:

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes.

About Our Work:

We are GDIT. A global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community.   • Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) with 14 years of experience; or Master's degree with 12 years of experience; or PhD with 9 years of experience
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with an active DoD Secret clearance with an investigation date within the last 6 years.

  • 1+ years of experience managing requirements in DOORS

  • 3+ years of experience working with MBSE tools (Cameo)
  • 1+ year of experience with Agile methodologies and tools (JIRA/Confluence)
  • 1+ years of experience supporting trades studies
  • 3+ years of experience with one or more of the following: C2, physical security, cybersecurity, communications systems, facility design, military aerospace development

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active DoD Top Secret Clearance
  • Experience in SysML or UPDM modeling languages
  • Proficiency with the DoDAF, UAF, or other modeling frameworks
  • Experience modeling with Cameo Enterprise Architecture, MagicDraw (No Magic, Inc.) or other architecture modeling tools

  • Experience with scripting and coding languages such as Python
